You will be the first point of contact for many of our clients, requiring a professional and persuasive communication style. We need someone flexible with a very good accent or tone of voice.

Outbound Prospecting: Conduct high-volume cold calls to generate leads and identify potential customers.

Lead Qualification: Evaluate prospect needs and qualify opportunities based on specific criteria.

Sales Execution: Manage the full sales cycle from initial contact to closing the deal.

Pipeline Management: Maintain an organized CRM to track interactions and follow-up schedules.



Candidate Requirements

Communication Style: Must possess a neutral tone of voice or a clear American accent to effectively engage with our primary market.

Persistence: A resilient "hunter" mentality with the ability to handle rejection professionally.

Experience: Proven experience in cold calling, telemarketing, or inside sales.

Equipment: A stable internet connection and a high-quality headset for clear communication.



Compensation & Perks

Base Rate: $5.00 – $8.00 per hour (commensurate with experience).

Growth: Opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment with a direct impact on company revenue.

title: Part-Time YouTube Video Editor & Channel Manager
description:
About the Role



I'm Dr. Mel, The Contracts Coach. I help small business owners, veterans, minority entrepreneurs, and mid-career professionals win government contracts using AI and real systems. I need a dedicated YouTube editor who can turn raw footage into polished, watch-time-optimized videos and build thumbnails that actually stop the scroll.



This is not a general admin VA role. I need someone who lives and breathes YouTube editing and channel growth strategy, not someone learning on the job.



The Real Goal (Be Direct With Me About This)



YouTube requires 4,000 watch hours in the trailing 12 months to qualify for monetization under current rules, and that threshold is set to double to 8,000 hours for new applicants starting February 1. I need to hit monetization before that date. This means every video needs to be edited for retention, not just posted. If you don't understand the difference between a video that gets views and a video that holds watch time, this isn't the right role for you.



What You'll Do

Edit raw footage (including livestream recordings and unscripted talking-head video) into clean, retention-optimized long-form YouTube videos

Repurpose existing short-form content (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts already filmed) into new long-form or Shorts uploads for YouTube

Design custom thumbnails for every video using our brand colors (bright green background, navy for text/CTAs, gold reserved only for the logo, never used elsewhere)

Write and optimize video titles, descriptions, and tags for search (not just clever captions, actual keyword research)

Manage the upload schedule (currently 3x/week, tapering to 2x/week then 1x/week over a 90-day cycle)

Track basic analytics (watch time, average view duration, click-through rate on thumbnails) and flag what's working so we can do more of it

Optionally repost finished long-form or Shorts content to other platforms 
, Instagram) if bandwidth allows, YouTube is the priority

What I Need From You

A portfolio or reel of YouTube edits you've personally done, not just "I know Premiere/CapCut," show me actual channel growth or retention results if you have them

Real understanding of what drives YouTube watch time and retention (hooks, pacing, pattern interrupts, thumbnail/title match), not just editing software skills

Ability to work independently from raw footage with minimal direction once you understand the brand voice

Comfortable using Claude AI as a daily work tool for scripting, research, and workflow support

Reliable, fast turnaround; content needs to go out on schedule, not "whenever it's done"



Software/Tools

Video editing software of your choice (CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci Resolve, etc, tell me what you use and why)

Canva or similar for thumbnails (must match provided brand guide: Yield Emerald green background, navy for text/buttons, white for supporting text, gold reserved for the logo only)

Core Values I Need From Anyone On My Team

Make an Impact — take ownership of the outcome, not just the task

Plan Ahead — think about what a video needs before I have to ask

Affirm and Communicate — tell me early if something's off track, not after a deadline is missed

description:
Vanguard Care Solutions is a licensed Maryland home care company. We run three brands from one GoHighLevel account: Vanguard Care Solutions, Vanguard Home Care, and Care Without Crisis, our free education program for families caring for aging parents.



The owner spends his week in the field meeting hospital discharge planners, social workers, and elder-law attorneys in person. The CRM has to run correctly while he is out of the building. That is the job.



Our account was built by one contractor with no documentation and no backup. It works, but we have outgrown it. We need someone senior who can take real ownership.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Build and maintain our tag and segmentation system. The architecture is already written and documented — you implement it, apply it to an existing under-labeled database, and keep it clean.

- Build
 sequences and workflows across six pipelines: three audience tracks with separate sender identities, plus behavior-triggered handoffs.

- Build suppression and exclusion rules as hard rules, not intentions. A referral partner must never receive a family education
.

- Own deliverability: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up, and complaint monitoring. We send all three brands from one address, so damage on one track follows us into the others.

- Build forms, landing pages, calendars, and UTM tracking.

- Maintain integrations with AxisCare, 
, and QuickBooks.

- Document everything in plain English and deliver a monthly data audit.



You are not writing the copy. Strategy, sequences, and subject lines are supplied to you. You build, test, document, and maintain.



REQUIREMENTS



Required: HighLevel Certified Admin (Foundational Track).

Strongly preferred: HighLevel Certified Workflow Specialist (Automation Track). Most of this role is automation, and this is the credential we weight most heavily.

Two or more years in GoHighLevel daily at admin level.

Real
 marketing depth — segmentation, suppression logic, list hygiene, deliverability. Not just sending campaigns.

Hands-on SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configuration at a DNS host.


 or Zapier, including error handling.

Available every weekday morning Eastern Time through 12:00 noon EST.

Clear written English and the discipline to document as you build.



Helpful but not required: GoHighLevel Companies or custom objects, API v2 and webhooks, LC Phone and IVR, US healthcare or another regulated industry.



We work under a Maryland state license. No patient information ever enters
, and nothing goes live untested. If you have worked somewhere that shipped first and fixed later, this is not that job.



HOW TO APPLY



Subject line, exactly: GHL CERTIFIED — CARDINAL

title: Senior Guest Operations Lead – Short-Term Rentals
description:
# Senior Guest Operations Lead – Short-Term Rentals



**Remote – Philippines | Full-Time | 40 Hours/Week**



## About Xenia Living



Xenia Living is a fast-growing hospitality company managing 80+ short and mid-term rental properties in Illinois.



We combine hospitality, technology, and strong operational systems to deliver exceptional experiences for guests and property owners.



We're looking for an exceptional **Senior Guest Operations Lead** to take ownership of our day-to-day guest operations and grow into a larger leadership role as the company scales.



**This is not a traditional VA role.** We're looking for an operator who thinks independently, exercises strong judgment, and takes ownership from problem to resolution.



## The Role



Your mission is simple:



**Make sure our guests have an exceptional experience and operational issues get resolved quickly, professionally, and without unnecessary escalation.**



When something goes wrong, you don't just assign a task or ask a manager what to do. You assess the situation, determine the best solution, coordinate the right people, communicate proactively, and follow through until it's resolved.



You'll own:



* Guest communication and escalations across Airbnb, VRBO, 
, direct reservations, and phone

* Cleaning and maintenance coordination, including urgent issues

* Reservation changes, extensions, early arrivals, late departures, refunds, and relocations within company policies

* Airbnb AirCover/damage claims and review management

* Daily operational execution inside Hostaway and related systems

* Tracking issues through completion and verifying work with photos/documentation

* Identifying recurring problems and improving the SOP, workflow, or system behind them

* Helping maintain exceptional guest satisfaction and a 4.8+ portfolio rating



## Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is unusually strong at **judgment, ownership, communication, and problem-solving.**



You should have:



* 3+ years of STR, vacation rental, hospitality, or property-management experience

* Strong Airbnb/OTA knowledge and experience with a PMS such as Hostaway, Guesty, or Hospitable

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Experience coordinating cleaners, maintenance teams, or vendors

* Strong judgment during difficult guest situations

* The ability to make decisions without constant supervision

* Exceptional follow-through and attention to detail

* Comfort working U.S. hours, including scheduled weekend coverage



Experience with Hostaway, Breezeway, PriceLabs, AirCover claims, Slack, ClickUp, AI, or automation tools is a plus.



## You'll Thrive Here If



You don't just complete tasks—you **own outcomes**.



You communicate before someone has to ask for an update.



You stay calm when several things go wrong at once.



And when the same problem happens twice, your instinct is to ask:



**"How do we prevent this from happening again?"**



## Growth Opportunity



We are intentionally looking for someone capable of becoming a future operational leader at Xenia Living.



The potential career path is:



**Senior Guest Operations Lead ? Operations Manager ? Director of Operations**



## Compensation & Benefits



* **$1,200–$1,600 USD/month**, depending on experience and demonstrated ability

* 13th-month pay

* Paid time off

* Performance-based compensation opportunities

* Long-term leadership growth



Exceptional candidates may be considered above the listed range.



## How to Apply



Please submit your résumé and a **maximum 2-minute video** answering:



1. Briefly describe your STR/hospitality operations experience.

2. Tell us about a difficult guest or operational problem you personally owned from beginning to end. What did you do?

3. Tell us about one process or system you improved at a previous company.



Please don't read from a script. We're interested in how you **think and communicate**, not a polished presentation.

title: Copywriter & Content Designer (Email + Social) - Digital Healthcare Brand
description:
About us



Bua Health is a digital healthcare provider focused on weight loss in Ireland. We help people access clinically appropriate weight loss care, including GLP-1 medications, through a doctor-led telehealth platform. We're small, moving fast, and we care a lot about how our brand shows up in front of people.



The role



We're looking for one person who can build our content world from the ground up: strategy, copy, and design, across both
 and social media. It needs to be world class content similar to 
, 
, and similar operators (please check out their social media).



The core of the role is craft. We want someone who can look at a blank page and think through what to say, who it's for, and why now, then write it, then design it into something that actually looks good in an inbox and in a feed.



You'll build a long-term
 nurture programme for people who come through our funnel and qualify for our weight loss programme, and you'll create ongoing social media content that builds the Bua brand as a trusted, human, doctor-led weight loss provider in Ireland.



This is a long-term role. You won't be managing live campaigns day to day - that sits with the wider team. Your job is to produce the content and set it up so it's ready to run.



What you'll do



 - Build the content strategy: what we say, to whom, and when, across
 sequences and social channels.

 - Write the copy:
s, captions, hooks, subject lines, short-form scripts. Warm, clear, human, medically responsible.

 - Design the finished output:
s and social posts that feel calm, credible, and premium. Canva preferred, but use whatever tool you're strongest in.

 - Generate any imagery you need using Gemini or similar tool of your choosing

- Ensure
 sequences can be implemented in Mailchimp so they're built, tested, and ready to fire.



*What we need you to be great at*



We think of this role as two halves, and we need both.



The strategy half:



Thinking through what a content programme should actually do for a considered healthcare purchase.

Segmenting audiences and mapping content journeys that make sense for where someone is in their decision.

Choosing hooks, angles, and formats that suit the platform and the moment.



The execution half:



Copy that reads like a real person wrote it, not a template.

Visual design that feels healthcare-appropriate. No stock-photo clichés, no over-designed noise, no wellness kitsch.

Enough Mailchimp fluency to build automations, segmentation, tagging, and conditional logic without breaking deliverability.



Nice to have



Prior work in health, wellness, or digital healthcare. Campaigns in those categories would be a real advantage.

Experience producing short-form video content or scripts, not just static posts.

Familiarity with the GLP-1 / weight loss category.



The AI part



We're AI-first and we expect you to be too. Use AI heavily in your workflow: drafting, ideation, image generation with Gemini, refinement. What we don't want is AI slop: generic openings, empty phrases, over-emojied captions, or bland AI-generated imagery. If you can tell the difference between good AI-assisted work and lazy AI-assisted work, we want to talk.



How to apply

 - A short intro (2 to 3 paragraphs, not a wall of CV) about who you are and why this fits.

 - 2 to 3 samples of your best
 content and social media content, ideally including both the copy and the finished design.

 - One example where you used AI in the process, with a short note on how you used it.

 - Your rate expectations in USD, monthly.



If you've read this far, please respond with CHICKEN in all caps at the top of your reply. We get a lot of auto-responses and this is how we find people who actually read the post.

CRM systems

Workflow automation

AI SDRs

Lead nurturing

Calendar and booking systems

APIs and webhooks

Third-party integrations

 and SMS automation

Sales technology



Hands-on experience with platforms such as GoHighLevel, Zapier, Make, and AI tools.

handoff.

Strong project-management and organizational skills.

Find suppliers as close as possible to the manufacturer/source.

Use trade fairs, exhibitor directories, LinkedIn, industry databases, brand websites, company registries and other professional sources.

We are NOT interested in simple Google lists of wholesalers.

Verify suppliers and identify the correct purchasing/export/sales contact.

Contact suppliers professionally using our company identity.

Apply for wholesale/B2B accounts.

Follow up with suppliers.

Obtain price lists, catalogues, EAN/GTIN lists and stock lists when available.

Obtain MOQ, shipping terms, payment terms and volume discount information.

Keep an organised record of all suppliers researched and contacted.



Initial categories:

Beauty & Personal Care, Pet Supplies, Kitchen & Home.



Important:

You will NOT perform Amazon product profitability analysis. We do this internally.



We are specifically looking for someone who can find less obvious suppliers and companies higher up the supply chain, not wholesalers that can be found in a few minutes with a basic Google search.



Experience in procurement, supplier sourcing, wholesale sourcing, import/export research, supply-chain research or B2B business development is strongly preferred.



Excellent written English is required.



To apply, start your application with: EU SOURCING



Then answer:



What experience do you have finding B2B suppliers, distributors or importers?

How would you find the official European importer/distributor for a specific brand?

What research methods or tools would you use besides normal Google searches?

Give one example of a difficult supplier/distributor you successfully found and explain how you found them.

What is your expected hourly rate?



Shortlisted applicants will receive a paid sourcing test.



We are looking for one reliable person for a long-term collaboration, not an agency selling generic supplier lists.

This is not purely an administrative Virtual Assistant position.



You will help us deliver an excellent guest experience, coordinate day-to-day property operations and actively generate more direct bookings. You should be comfortable taking ownership of your work, organising your own weekly schedule and finding new ways to produce results.



You will receive training on our systems and processes. However, we are looking for someone who can eventually work independently, identify what needs attention and take initiative without requiring constant supervision.



Your responsibilities



Guest experience and operations



* Responding to inbound calls and messages from guests, prospective guests, booking platforms and housekeeping teams

* Making outbound calls for callbacks, enquiries and follow-ups

* Managing guest communication before, during and after each stay

* Managing the company inbox and maintaining an organised, near-zero inbox

* Coordinating maintenance when required

* Monitoring and responding appropriately to guest feedback and reviews

* Creating and updating documents, spreadsheets and other business materials

* Keeping accurate records and communicating important updates to the team

* Learning and using our property-management and communication systems



Direct-booking marketing and lead generation



* Marketing our properties through relevant
 groups, pages and other suitable online channels

* Identifying local construction projects, contractors, businesses and organisations that may need accommodation

* Contacting prospective clients professionally by
, telephone, social media or other appropriate methods

* Following up enquiries and nurturing potential clients

* Maintaining an organised record of prospects, conversations and follow-up dates

* Helping convert suitable enquiries into profitable direct bookings

* Suggesting and testing new methods of generating direct bookings

* Building relationships that can lead to repeat and longer-term accommodation bookings

We welcome creative and ethical approaches to securing direct bookings. The successful candidate will be encouraged to propose new ideas rather than simply wait for instructions.



Performance reporting



You will be expected to plan your weekly activities around agreed priorities and submit a concise weekly KPI report.

* New prospective clients identified

* Outreach messages and calls completed

* Qualified leads generated

* Follow-ups completed

* Direct-booking enquiries received

* Direct bookings secured

* Direct-booking revenue generated

* Guest response times

* Outstanding guest or operational issues

* Priorities and planned activities for the following week

ByShameel is a garment research and fashion product development studio working with culture-led brands across fashion, streetwear, gymwear, athlete/influencer brands, artist merchandise, lifestyle, sports, and e-commerce.

ByShameel works with brands that already have motion - audience, sales, cultural relevance, upcoming launches, or product development needs - and helps turn unclear product ideas into stronger, more defined product systems.



About the Role:

ByShameel is looking for a Business Development Coordinator / Lead Research Specialist to support lead research, CRM organization, and pipeline development.



This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, strong at online research, and interested in fashion, e-commerce, streetwear, creator brands, and culture-led businesses.



The: Business Development Coordinator / Lead Research Specialist will help identify potential client opportunities, research brands and decision makers, organize lead information, track business signals, and support outreach preparation.



This is a research and coordination role designed to support business development. It is not a sales closing role.



Why This Role Matters:

ByShameel is building a more consistent business development system around a growing studio.



This role will help create structure around the pipeline by identifying qualified brand opportunities, organizing lead information, tracking follow-ups, and helping ensure the studio is consistently aware of strong potential clients.



The right person will help turn research into organized business opportunities.



What You’ll Do:

- Research potential client leads across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, websites, Shopify stores, Google, and other online sources

- Track follow-up dates and help keep the business development pipeline organized

- Prepare weekly lead research summaries and pipeline updates

- 2+ years of experience in lead research, business development support, sales support, market research, CRM management, sales operations, or a related role

- Strong online research skills across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Google, websites, and e-commerce stores

title: BILLING SUPPORT SPECIALIST
description:
BILLING SUPPORT SPECIALIST



Assistant Biller & Credentialing Backup Specialist



Reports to



Operations Director, and/or Executive Director



Position type



Part-time or full-time, based on organizational need



Organization



Wings of the Future, NFP



Position Summary



Wings of the Future is seeking a dependable, detail-oriented Billing Support Specialist to support day-to-day billing operations and provide backup coverage for provider credentialing. This role works closely with the Lead Biller, credentialing staff, leadership, providers, and administrative team members to improve claim accuracy, reduce preventable delays, support timely reimbursement, and maintain complete, audit-ready records.



A central responsibility of this position is the accurate setup and maintenance of clients’ primary and secondary insurance coverage. The successful candidate must be able to build insurance profiles in the billing system, confirm coordination of benefits, determine correct payer order, and support proper submission of primary and secondary claims.



Role purpose: Provide accurate, timely billing support and dependable credentialing backup—not replace the Lead Biller or Credentialing Coordinator.



Essential Duties and Responsibilities



1. Primary and Secondary Insurance Setup and Coordination



• Build, update, and maintain primary and secondary insurance profiles in the billing system and/or electronic health record.

• Accurately enter payer names, member and group numbers, plan types, effective and termination dates, subscriber information, relationship to subscriber, claims addresses, payer IDs, and other required fields.

• Verify which coverage is primary and which is secondary using payer information and coordination-of-benefits requirements; do not guess when payer order is unclear.

• Confirm active coverage, benefits, patient responsibility, authorization requirements, and payer-specific billing rules before claims are submitted.

• Update coordination-of-benefits information and flag coverage conflicts, inactive policies, duplicate coverage, or missing information for prompt resolution.

• Support correct sequencing of primary and secondary claims, including submission of required primary-payer remittance information to the secondary payer.

• Track crossover claims and manually submit secondary claims when automatic crossover does not occur.

• Help prevent duplicate billing, incorrect payer billing, untimely filing, and avoidable denials related to insurance setup or payer order.

2. Claim Preparation and Submission Support



• Prepare, review, batch, submit, and track claims under the direction of the Lead Biller.

• Check client demographics, insurance details, payer information, rendering and billing provider data, dates of service, CPT/HCPCS codes, ICD-10 codes, modifiers, units, place of service, authorizations, and other required claim elements.

• Identify missing, incomplete, inconsistent, or incorrect information before claim submission.

• Follow payer-specific requirements, internal billing workflows, and timely-filing deadlines.

• Maintain accurate claim logs, billing records, and supporting documentation.

3. Documentation and Billing Readiness



• Confirm that required service notes, signatures, dates, treatment plans, assessments, authorizations, service logs, and other billing documentation are present.

• Track outstanding documentation and promptly notify the appropriate staff member when records are missing or incomplete.

• Identify basic documentation gaps that may delay or prevent billing without replacing clinical supervision or clinical review.

4. Eligibility and Authorization Support



• Verify insurance eligibility and benefits at intake and as required throughout service delivery.

• Maintain authorization numbers, approved dates, units, service types, expiration dates, and payer-specific requirements.

• Alert the Lead Biller and appropriate leadership when an authorization is missing, incorrect, exhausted, or nearing expiration.

• Review payer portals and communicate payer-related concerns as directed.

5. Payment Posting, Reconciliation, and Accounts Receivable



• Post or assist with posting payments, adjustments, and patient responsibility accurately in the billing system.

• Review EOBs, ERAs, payment reports, and payer portals; match payments to claims and accounts.

• Identify unpaid claims, underpayments, overpayments, recoupments, adjustments, and other discrepancies for review.

• Support monthly reconciliation, accounts-receivable tracking, aging review, and billing-report preparation.

6. Denial, Rejection, and Claim Follow-Up



• Track denied, rejected, unpaid, pending, and delayed claims, including primary and secondary claims.

• Research denial reasons, correct basic claim errors as directed, and prepare corrected claims or resubmissions.

• Gather records needed for reconsiderations, appeals, medical-necessity review, or payer follow-up.

• Identify recurring denial patterns and escalate trends that may require workflow, documentation, credentialing, or payer-contract corrections.

7. Credentialing and Payer Enrollment Backup



• Provide backup support for provider credentialing, recredentialing, payer enrollment, and roster maintenance.

• Collect and organize licenses, liability insurance, NPI and taxonomy information, CAQH records, resumes, certifications, board information, W-9 forms, background checks, and other payer-required documents.

• Track application status, payer effective dates, approval dates, follow-up deadlines, and provider participation status.

• Monitor expiration dates and follow up on missing, outdated, or incomplete provider documents.

• Assist with CAQH updates and attestations, NPI information, payer applications, portal activity, and credentialing logs when authorized.

• Maintain secure, complete, accurate, and audit-ready provider credentialing files.

• Support credentialing coverage when the primary credentialing team member is unavailable.

8. Communication, Compliance, and Record Maintenance



• Provide timely status updates, document completed work, and ask questions whenever instructions or payer rules are unclear.

• Communicate professionally with staff, providers, payer representatives, and credentialing departments as authorized.

• Maintain accurate client billing profiles, payer records, electronic files, spreadsheets, and tracking logs.

• Follow HIPAA, privacy, security, billing, credentialing, documentation, and organizational compliance requirements.

• Protect client, provider, insurance, credentialing, clinical, and financial information at all times.

• Report suspected errors, inconsistencies, privacy concerns, or compliance issues promptly; never make unauthorized changes to records.

Required Qualifications



• Demonstrated ability to build and maintain primary and secondary insurance coverage in a billing system or electronic health record.

• Working knowledge of coordination of benefits, payer order, primary-to-secondary claim sequencing, EOB/ERA review, and secondary claim submission.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and deadline management.

• Ability to protect confidential information and consistently follow HIPAA and organizational privacy requirements.

• Professional written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to follow detailed procedures, learn payer requirements, work independently, accept feedback, and ask for clarification rather than guess.

• Comfort using billing software, electronic health records, spreadsheets,
, payer portals, and online credentialing systems.

Preferred Qualifications



• Experience in behavioral health, mental health, medical, Medicaid, managed-care, private-insurance, or nonprofit healthcare billing.

• Experience with claim submission, payment posting, accounts receivable, denial management, corrected claims, appeals, and reconciliation.

• Knowledge of CPT/HCPCS codes, ICD-10 codes, modifiers, service units, authorizations, and timely-filing requirements.

• Experience with provider credentialing, payer enrollment, CAQH, NPI, taxonomy codes, roster maintenance, or credentialing file management.

• Experience reviewing EOBs, ERAs, payer portals, credentialing portals, and aging reports.

Core Competencies



• Reliable, accurate, organized, ethical, and consistent.

• Calm under pressure and able to manage repetitive, detail-heavy work.

• Respectful, accountable, receptive to coaching, and committed to correcting errors promptly.

• Able to manage billing and credentialing priorities without losing track of deadlines or confidential information.

• Aligned with Wings of the Future’s mission and commitment to integrity, service, and sustainable care.

Typical Daily and Weekly Activities



• Build or update primary and secondary insurance profiles and resolve coordination-of-benefits questions.

• Verify eligibility, benefits, payer order, and authorization status.

• Review claims and documentation for billing readiness; update billing logs.

• Track primary claims, secondary claims, crossover status, denials, rejections, and unpaid balances.

• Post payments, review remittance information, and support reconciliation and aging follow-up.

• Update credentialing trackers, follow up on missing provider documents, and monitor expirations.

• Attend billing or credentialing check-ins and complete assigned tasks by deadline.

Performance Expectations and Success Measures



• Accurate setup and maintenance of primary and secondary insurance records.

• Correct payer sequencing and fewer preventable claim errors or denials related to insurance setup.

• Timely completion of claims, follow-up tasks, credentialing assignments, and documentation reviews.

• Reduced billing backlog and faster identification of missing information.

• Organized, current, and audit-ready billing and credentialing records.

• Clear communication, consistent confidentiality, dependable attendance, strong follow-through, and steady growth in billing, payer, credentialing, and organizational workflow knowledge.

Training and Supervision



The Lead Biller, Credentialing Coordinator, and/or leadership will provide training on the organization’s systems, workflows, documentation standards, payer procedures, claim submission, denial tracking, payment posting, credentialing requirements, and confidentiality expectations. The employee is expected to take notes, follow established procedures, ask questions, incorporate feedback, and become increasingly independent as competency is demonstrated.



Confidentiality



This position has access to sensitive client, clinical, provider, insurance, credentialing, and financial information. Strict confidentiality and compliance with all applicable privacy laws, ethical standards, payer requirements, and organizational policies are conditions of employment. A breach of confidentiality or intentional falsification of billing or credentialing information may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination.



Mission Alignment



Accurate billing and credentialing allow Wings of the Future to remain financially stable, support its providers, serve clients, and expand services for individuals and families in need. This position plays an essential behind-the-scenes role in helping the organization operate with excellence, integrity, and sustainability.



Equal Opportunity Statement



Wings of the Future is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.



How to Apply



Please submit a resume and a brief statement describing your billing experience, your experience building primary and secondary insurance coverage, your familiarity with coordination of benefits and secondary claims, any credentialing or payer-enrollment experience, and your interest in supporting Wings of the Future.

title: Etsy Print-on-Demand Specialist

What I Offer:

Steady, reliable pay with weekly PayPal payments every Sunday

Weekly performance bonus

Fully remote: work from anywhere with reliable internet

Real training with Loom videos, written guides, and hands-on coaching

A boss who respects your time; I don't micromanage, and I don't expect you online 24/7

A mission-driven brand — we make products that celebrate teachers, therapists, and everyday people doing meaningful work



About The Shop

I run a growing Etsy print-on-demand shop with 1,000+ five-star reviews. We focus on personalized products for:



Teachers

Therapists

Autism advocates & special education professionals

Weddings, bridal showers, and engagement gifts

Moms, grandmas, and family gifting



I'm actively scaling the business, and I need a great partner to help me get there.



Who I'm Looking For

Self-motivated & resourceful: you Google before asking me, and you figure things out

Reliable & consistent

Kind and warm in customer service: you actually care about the buyer's experience

Eager to learn: willing to watch training videos, take notes, and try new things

Honest about mistakes: everyone messes up sometimes; the good ones own it and fix it



What a Day-to-Day Would Look Like

Your workday would include a mix of:

Customer service — replying to Etsy messages warmly, professionally, and quickly

Order fulfillment — sending orders through Printify with the correct designs and variants

Basic design work in Canva — personalizing templates with customer names and details

Listing help — uploading new products to Etsy and Printify

Etsy shop management — organizing orders into folders, tagging, and general upkeep



You do NOT need to be a graphic designer or business expert. I'll teach you everything you need to know. What you need to bring is attention to detail, warmth in customer service, and the willingness to learn.



Required Skills

Excellent written English

Comfortable using a computer with Google Chrome, Google Sheets, and basic web tools

High Level of Organization and Detail-Oriented Work Ethic

Basic experience with Canva OR the willingness to learn it quickly

Reliable high-speed internet

Able to work consistent hours 7 days a week (about 1-2 hours per day to start)



Big Pluses (Not Required)

Experience with Etsy (as a seller, buyer, or VA)

Experience with Printify or other print-on-demand platforms

Confidence in Canva

Experience handling customer service messages

Comfortable following Loom video training



Tools You'll Use

Etsy Shop Manager

Printify

Canva

Google Sheets & Google Docs

Loom (for watching training videos)

WhatsApp or Slack

LastPass

PayPal (for payment)



Position & Pay

Position: Part-time to start

Growth path: Additional hours available as you take on more responsibility

Pay: $5 USD per hour (paid weekly via PayPal every Sunday)

Bonus weekly depending on error rates and quality of work



Contract: Independent contractor (you'll sign an Independent Contractor Agreement and NDA)

Start date: As soon as we find a great match



How to Apply

To be considered, you MUST do BOTH of these things — applications missing either step will be automatically disqualified:



1. Reply to this job post on OnlineJobs.ph with:

Your resume/CV

A short intro paragraph about yourself

Your availability (time zone + working hours)

2. Complete this quick questionnaire (about 15 minutes): 



If you pass Round 1, I'll message you directly with the next step. There are 3 rounds total: this questionnaire, a Google Sheets task, and a longer set of questions about you and your experience. Only the top applicants will be invited to a short video interview at the end.



A Note From Me



I know applying for jobs is stressful. I'm reading every single application personally, and I appreciate you taking the time to apply. If you're excited about this role, tell me why in your reply! That means a lot to me.



Good luck, and I hope to find someone amazing like you to join me!



— Meghan

title: Recruiter / Hiring Manager — Home Care

We're a family-owned California in-home senior care company, founded in 1996 by Ken and Carrie Ballard. Nearly 30 years later, we're still family-run — now across six locations from Sacramento to San Diego.



Our caregivers are the heart of what we do, and we're looking for someone who loves finding great ones. If you're an experienced healthcare recruiter who gets a genuine kick out of filling a pipeline and watching your numbers climb, we'd love to meet you.



## What You'll Be Doing

- Full-cycle recruiting for CNAs, HHAs, Medical Assistants, and caregivers

- Managing job postings and candidate flow across **Indeed, Apploi, Manatal, and myCNAjobs**

- Tracking every candidate through our **GoHighLevel CRM** — keeping pipeline stages current and running SMS/email outreach through our workflows

- Phone screening candidates, verifying certifications, and getting interviews on the calendar with our branch managers

- **Providing, collecting, and following up on all employment documentation** — including HCA (Home Care Aide) registration, Live Scan background checks, TB clearance, and new-hire paperwork. You'll chase what's missing and keep every file moving until the candidate is cleared to work.

- Building a warm bench of pre-screened talent so we're never scrambling when a new case comes in

- Hitting your weekly hiring targets and sending a quick **End-of-Day report** so we always know where things stand



## What We're Looking For



- A seasoned recruiter — this one's not entry-level

- **Real experience hiring CNAs, HHAs, MAs, and caregivers** in home care or home health

- Comfortable and quick inside **Indeed, Apploi, Manatal, and myCNAjobs** (or able to pick up any of them fast)

- **Familiar with GoHighLevel (GHL)** — you'll use our CRM and workflows daily for candidate tracking, pipeline stages, and outreach

- **Fluent, clearly understandable spoken English** — you'll be on the phone with US candidates and managers all day

- Someone who's motivated by targets, stays organized under volume, and is happy to check in daily

- Comfortable owning compliance paperwork start to finish — you don't mind the follow-up it takes to get a file complete. California HCA registration and background check experience is a big plus.

- A reliable computer, solid internet, and a quiet space for calls

- **Full-time**, [XX] hours/week, with overlap on Pacific Time business hours



## One Thing We Ask: Send Us a Video



We'd love to see you before we meet you — **applications without a video won't be reviewed.**



Just 2–3 minutes on your phone, no script needed:

1. A little about your recruiting background

2. Your experience hiring CNAs, HHAs, MAs, and caregivers

3. Which hiring platforms you use, and how you work in them

4. One recruiting number you're proud of

5. Why Golden Years feels like a fit for you



Upload to Loom, Google Drive, or unlisted YouTube, and make sure anyone with the link can view it.



## Ready to Apply?



Send your **resume** and **video link** to [application link/email], along with your average monthly hires in your most recent role. We read every application that includes a video, and we'll get back to you.



---

title: Meta Media Buyer
description:
NOTE: Please do not apply if you primarily have lead gen experience.



About Lucyd



Lucyd is a performance marketing and growth agency helping ambitious wellness brands scale through acquisition, retention, creative strategy, and conversion optimization.



We specialize in building scalable growth systems for brands operating in policy-constrained wellness, including hemp, cannabis, telehealth (including GLP-1s and research peptides), supplements, and functional wellness products.



We are more than an agency executing individual services. We operate as integrated growth partners embedded in our clients’ businesses, helping them solve challenges across the entire customer journey—from customer acquisition and retention to creative, websites, and conversion optimization.



Our team moves quickly, communicates transparently, and operates with a high level of ownership and accountability. We care deeply about outcomes, strategic thinking, operational excellence, and long-term client partnerships.



---



Why This Role Exists



The Media Buyer, Paid Social is responsible for bringing growth strategies to life through exceptional execution on Meta.



Working closely with a Growth Strategist, you’ll build, launch, optimize, and scale paid social campaigns that drive profitable growth for our clients. You’ll combine strong platform expertise with analytical thinking to make informed optimization decisions, uncover opportunities through data, and continuously improve campaign performance.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys executing at a high level, thrives in fast-paced environments, and takes pride in operational excellence.



---



Working in Complex Advertising Environments



Lucyd specializes in helping brands grow in industries where advertising is rarely straightforward.



Many of our clients operate in highly regulated or policy-constrained categories, including hemp-derived cannabinoids, cannabis-adjacent products, telehealth services, GLP-1s, peptides, supplements, and functional wellness products.



Success in these industries requires more than platform expertise. It requires curiosity, adaptability, strategic thinking, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches while operating within evolving platform policies.



We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex advertising challenges and can consistently find innovative ways to help clients scale responsibly.



---



What You’ll Own



Campaign Execution & Optimization



- Build, launch, manage, and optimize Meta advertising campaigns across a portfolio of DTC ecommerce clients.

- Execute testing plans across audiences, creatives, placements, budgets, and campaign structures.

- Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimization decisions that improve efficiency and profitability.

- Manage campaign budgets and pacing while maintaining alignment with client performance goals.

- Troubleshoot campaign delivery issues, tracking discrepancies, and platform-related challenges.



Performance Analysis



- Analyze campaign performance using Meta Ads Manager and supporting analytics platforms.

- Identify trends across creative, messaging, audiences, offers, and funnel performance.

- Understand *why* creative is succeeding or underperforming, using performance data to generate actionable insights.

- Monitor key performance metrics including MER, aMER, CAC, bCAC, CPA, CPM, and other leading indicators.

- Prepare performance updates and reporting for internal stakeholders and client-facing meetings.



Cross-Functional Collaboration



- Partner closely with Growth Strategists to execute paid media strategies across assigned accounts.

- Collaborate with Creative teams by providing data-backed recommendations for new concepts, messaging angles, hooks, offers, and creative testing opportunities.

- Contribute ideas during creative strategy discussions while helping ensure creative testing aligns with account priorities.

- Communicate proactively with internal teams regarding campaign performance, blockers, and opportunities.

- Participate in client calls as needed and communicate confidently in written client updates.



---



What Success Looks Like



Successful Media Buyers consistently:



- Execute campaigns accurately, efficiently, and with exceptional attention to detail.

- Achieve client MER, aMER, CAC and bCAC goals through disciplined optimization and testing.

- Move quickly while maintaining a high standard of quality.

- Communicate proactively and collaborate effectively across teams.

- Complete work reliably, follow established processes, and demonstrate strong operational excellence.

- Use data to identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve performance over time.



---



What You Bring to the Table



Required



- 3+ years of experience managing Meta advertising for DTC ecommerce brands.

- Agency experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

- Experience managing six-figure monthly Meta advertising budgets.

- Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign structure, audience strategy, and optimization best practices.

- Experience working with Shopify and/or WooCommerce ecommerce brands.

- Ability to analyze creative performance and identify the drivers behind winning and losing campaigns.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make informed optimization decisions.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Strong written communication skills and comfort participating in client meetings when needed.

- Experience working successfully in a remote environment.

- Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.



Preferred



- Experience working with third-party attribution platforms such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Hyros, or similar.

- Experience advertising within policy-constrained wellness industries, including hemp, cannabis, telehealth (GLP-1s, peptides), supplements, and functional wellness.

- Experience managing campaigns on TikTok, X, or Snapchat.

- Familiarity with GA4 and ecommerce analytics.

- Experience collaborating closely with creative teams on performance marketing initiatives.



---



Who Thrives at Lucyd



Successful Paid Social Media Buyers at Lucyd are proactive, detail-oriented operators who enjoy turning strategy into execution.



They are analytical, adaptable, and naturally curious about what drives performance. They communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and move quickly without sacrificing quality. They thrive in collaborative environments, enjoy solving complex problems with data, and embrace continuous learning as advertising platforms evolve.

- Prepare and issue RFQs to approved and prospective vendors

- Compare technical and commercial quotations

The ideal candidate understands that industrial procurement is not simply purchasing the cheapest available part. You should be able to evaluate equipment requirements, operational criticality, compatibility, lead time, vendor reliability, and lifecycle cost.

- 3+ years of oil & gas, petrochemical, energy, industrial plant, or heavy-equipment procurement experience

title: Construction Project Controls / Project Management Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Construction Project Controls / Project Management Specialist to support the planning, coordination, cost control, procurement, and documentation of commercial and industrial construction projects.



This is not a CAD or drafting position. The role focuses on the operational and commercial work required to keep construction projects organized, on schedule, and within budget.



Responsibilities include:



- Track project schedules, milestones, dependencies, and delays

- Maintain project budgets, committed costs, forecasts, and cost reports

- Review contractor and subcontractor quotations

- Prepare bid comparisons and procurement recommendations

- Track purchase orders, subcontracts, material deliveries, and long-lead items

- Manage RFIs and follow outstanding responses

- Track submittals, shop drawings, approvals, and material samples

- Maintain change-order and variation logs

- Review change-order documentation and supporting cost information

- Track progress against contract requirements and project schedules

- Coordinate with project managers, engineers, subcontractors, suppliers, and clients

- Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, action-item trackers, and status reports

- Maintain document-control systems and ensure teams are working from current information

- Review invoices, progress billings, and supporting documentation

- Identify schedule, procurement, cost, and contractual risks before they affect the project

- Track punch-list items, closeout documentation, warranties, and handover requirements

- Maintain organized records of project correspondence and decisions



You should be comfortable taking an ambiguous project issue, reviewing the available documentation and history, identifying what is outstanding, and coordinating the appropriate next steps.



Examples may include:



- A subcontractor claims a delay resulted from a late RFI response. Review the timeline and supporting records and determine the impact.

- A critical equipment delivery has slipped by six weeks. Determine which project activities are affected and coordinate mitigation options.

- Three subcontractors submit different quotations for the same scope. Normalize the bids and identify exclusions or commercial differences.

- A client requests a scope change after work has begun. Document the change, obtain pricing, track approval, and update the project forecast.



Preferred Qualifications:



- 3+ years of construction project coordination, project controls, cost control, procurement, or contract-administration experience

- Experience with commercial, industrial, infrastructure, or large residential construction

- Strong knowledge of RFIs, submittals, change orders, procurement, and project documentation

- Experience with Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Oracle, SAP, or similar systems

- Strong Excel and spreadsheet skills

- Ability to interpret contracts, scopes of work, schedules, quotations, and project correspondence

- Experience coordinating subcontractors and suppliers

- Strong written English, organization, and attention to detail



Please describe the types and sizes of construction projects you have supported, your primary responsibilities, and the project-management systems you have used.

description:

You’ll manage document requests from beginning to completion, working with government offices, archives, churches, and other record custodians to obtain official copies of vital and historical records.

s

title: SMS + Phone Appointment Setter (Part-Time, Warm Leads)
description:
SALARY



$4 USD/hour base + $5 USD per qualified booked call

(~20–25 hrs/week ? $350–400/mo base; strong setters realistically earn $550–700+/mo with bookings)



TYPE / HOURS



Part-time, ~20–25 hours/week, spread across all 7 days (including weekends). Hours are on U.S. Eastern time, which means this is a night-shift role in the Philippines. Only apply if you genuinely want to work U.S. hours.





ABOUT THE ROLE



We help people in the U.S. claim their Canadian citizenship by descent. People apply through our website and give us their phone number — so every lead you contact has already raised their hand. This is NOT cold calling.



Your job is to reach these warm leads fast, by text AND phone, build trust, answer their questions, and book them into a 15-minute call with our team.



Here's the catch we need you to solve: right now, replies are piling up and leads go quiet. A lot of them are unsure if we're legit (you'll literally get "how do I know this is real?" and "your number comes up as a scam"). Text alone isn't closing the gap — we need someone who will pick up the phone, sound warm and credible, and get the call booked. The setters who win at this do both: a quick text to warm it up, then a call.



You'll work through our texting platform (SendBlue) and call from a U.S. number we provide.





WHAT YOU'LL DO





Respond FAST to inbound leads — speed is everything

Run the winning sequence: send a quick intro text, then call the lead (we'll train you on this)

Talk to leads on the phone: build rapport, answer common questions, calmly handle "is this legit?"

Qualify leads with a few simple questions (e.g., do they have a Canadian-born parent or grandparent)

Book qualified leads into a 15-minute call on our calendar

Follow up by text and call with people who went quiet

Keep the conversation list clean — no lead left unanswered

Log notes and update lead status so nothing slips







WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR





Clear, confident spoken English with a neutral accent — you'll be on the phone with cautious U.S. leads, so they need to trust your voice immediately. (This is the #1 requirement and we will assess it from your video — see below.)

Excellent written English — natural and friendly over text

Comfortable and confident making and taking phone calls (this is a phone-forward role)

Reliable and self-managing across a 7-day schedule — consistency matters more than long hours

Fast and responsive — quick replies and quick dials are what book calls

Experience with chat/SMS, phone, or CRM tools (SendBlue, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, dialers — a plus)

Available on U.S. Eastern hours, including weekends

Stable internet, a quiet place to take calls, a reliable computer, and a good headset





Bonus (not required):





Prior appointment-setting, sales, telemarketing, customer support, or live-chat experience

Experience working with U.S.-based leads or customers







COMPENSATION DETAILS





Base: $4 USD/hour for scheduled hours (~20–25 hrs/week)

Booked-call bonus: $5 USD for every qualified booked call



"Qualified" = the lead confirms a specific date/time, has a real Canadian-born parent or grandparent, and is genuinely interested. (We pay for quality bookings, not junk.)







Paid weekly or bi-weekly (your preference)

Long-term role. Reliable performers get raises and more hours.







HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY — incomplete applications are deleted)



1. Start your message with the word "MAPLE" at the very top, so I know you actually read this.



2. Record a short custom video (2–3 minutes) — THIS IS REQUIRED. No video = no consideration. In the video:





Introduce yourself on camera, speaking in English so we can hear you clearly

Tell us specifically why YOU are a good fit for THIS role — not a generic intro. Mention that it's a text + phone setting role and that you'd be calling warm leads about Canadian citizenship. Reusing an old generic VA video will be obvious; we want one made for this job.

Briefly describe any experience you have calling or texting leads, setting appointments, or doing sales/support

End with this: pretend a lead just said "How do I know this is even legit?" — say out loud, in your own words, exactly how you'd respond to keep them comfortable and move toward booking a quick call.

Upload it to Google Drive, YouTube (unlisted), or Loom and paste the link.





3. In writing, tell me: your available hours per week, and which days/times (in U.S. Eastern time) you can work.



Applications that don't start with "MAPLE" or don't include the custom video will not be reviewed.



We'll run a short paid trial with real conversations before any long-term offer. Strong setters stay on long-term.



Looking forward to hearing your voice!

title: Operations Auditor & Case-Tracking Manager — Keep Every Citizenship Case Moving
description:
Job Description

About us



We're a done-for-you genealogy service that helps people around the world claim Canadian citizenship by descent. Canada changed its citizenship law in 2025 and scrapped the old generational cutoffs — which means millions of people with a Canadian parent, grandparent, or great-grandparent may already be citizens and have no idea.



Here's what we actually do: someone comes to us knowing almost nothing about their Canadian roots. We find the Canadian ancestor hiding in their family tree, track down the historical records that prove the bloodline — parish registers, century-old Quebec church books, BAnQ archives, US vital records offices — and hand them a complete, ready-to-submit citizenship application. A few weeks later, they're holding proof that they're Canadian. That's the work we're all here to do.



We're a small, remote team by design — no call center, no red tape. Real people, real records, real outcomes.



The role



Every record we request for a client lives as a card on a Kanban board, moving from Pending (request placed) to Received (document in hand). Those records are the whole ballgame — a case can't move forward until they land. Our account managers initiate and own the orders. The problem: some requests quietly stall in "Pending" for days or weeks, and nobody notices until a client asks. Those stuck cards cost us time, money, and — worse — a client's trust.



Your job is to make sure that never happens.



You are the safety net. You own the audit of our "Work Off" board — the cards that aren't actively being touched — and you keep the entire pipeline clean. You're not the one who initiates new orders (the account managers own that), but when you spot a stuck card with a clear solution, you're empowered to act on it yourself — place or re-place an order, or contact the provider directly — instead of passing it back. You are the person who catches what falls through the cracks, chases it down, and makes sure every single card keeps moving until it's marked Received.



If you love order, hate loose ends, and get genuine satisfaction from turning a messy board into a clean one, this is your role. This starts as a hands-on audit role and is built to grow into full ownership of the board — including setting the process and managing other auditors as we scale.



What you'll do day to day

Sweep the Work Off board every day and flag every card that has stalled or is aging past its expected timeline.

Verify that cards genuinely moved from Pending ? Received (and that "Received" actually means the document arrived — no false completions).

Chase down stuck cards and get them moving again — confirm status, then either follow up with the responsible account manager or, when there's a clear fix, take action yourself (place/re-place the order, or contact the provider directly).

Escalate only what you genuinely can't resolve into the Stuck queue, with clear notes on what's holding it up.

Define and maintain aging thresholds (e.g. "a birth-record order untouched for X days is flagged") so detection is systematic, not guesswork.

Keep a short daily/weekly log of what was stuck, what you cleared, and what's still open.

Over time: own the board's process end to end and help train/manage additional auditors.

How this role works (act, don't just flag)

You are not the primary order-initiator — the account managers own kicking off new orders. Your focus stays on pending and stuck cards, not starting fresh ones.

But you're empowered to act, not just flag. When a stuck card has a clear solution, you can place or re-place the order and communicate with the provider or relevant party yourself — rather than bouncing it back to the account manager.

You are the follow-up and quality-control layer that makes sure every card reaches Received.

Why you'll actually like working here (the honest version)



Let's be real about the day-to-day: this is detail work. You'll live inside a task board, you'll run the same sweep every day, and a lot of your best wins are quiet ones — the card that didn't fall through the cracks. If that kind of order-keeping bores you, this isn't your role. If a clean board gives you a little hit of satisfaction, you'll love it here.



What makes it genuinely good:



The mission is real. Every card you unstick moves an actual person closer to citizenship. You're not tracking widgets — you're the reason someone's claim to their heritage doesn't die in a queue.

It's basically detective work. Our records come from parish registers, Quebec dioceses, and century-old archives. Cases have twists and dead ends and satisfying breakthroughs. It's more interesting than your average admin gig.

Small team, real ownership. You'll work directly with the people who built this — no layers, no bureaucracy. Your work is visible and it matters the same day you do it.

Room to grow. This role is built to expand into owning the whole board and managing other auditors as we scale. Prove it out and you grow with us.

Fully remote, steady, long-term. A clear routine, clear expectations, and teammates who actually notice when you keep things clean.



You're a great fit if you

Have obsessive attention to detail — you notice the one card out of 200 that's off.

Are highly organized and process-minded — you think in checklists, thresholds, and "did this actually get done?"

Are comfortable living inside a Kanban / task board all day (Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Notion, or similar).

Are a proactive, polite follow-up person — you'll nudge teammates repeatedly without being annoying, and you don't let things drop.

Are comfortable communicating with outside parties by phone and
 (record providers, offices, and similar) clearly and professionally — you'll make calls during US business hours to keep cases moving.

Have the judgment to know when to act vs. escalate — you resolve what you can yourself and flag only what genuinely needs the account manager.

Have strong written English and can communicate status clearly and briefly.

Are reliable and consistent — this role is about showing up and doing the sweep every single day.

Can manage high volume without losing track, and want to grow into owning the process.

Nice to have (not required)

Experience in operations, QA, project coordination, order management, or a records/genealogy/vital-records workflow.

Experience managing or training a small remote team.

Details

Type: Full-time, long-term. (Open to part-time to start for the right person — see salary below.)

Hours: Full-time, with a solid daily overlap with US Eastern business hours (9am–5pm ET). This role makes phone calls to records offices, archives, and providers, so daytime EST overlap is required.

Pay: $1,000–$1,200/month to start, with reviews and room to grow to $1,400–$1,600 as you take on more of the board.

How to Apply (screening — keep this in)



To apply, please do the following exactly:



Put the word CLEARED at the very top of your message (so I know you actually read this posting).

In writing, tell me: (a) a time you were responsible for making sure nothing fell through the cracks — a system you kept clean or a backlog you cleared, and (b) which task/Kanban tools you've used and how many items you were tracking at once.

Record a short video (60–90 seconds) and include the link — a Loom, Google Drive, or unlisted YouTube link all work. In the video:

Introduce yourself, and

Answer this scenario out loud: You notice a card has sat in "Pending" for 12 days with no update. Walk me through exactly what you'd do, step by step.

No fancy editing needed — I just want to hear your English and how you think through a problem. A video is required to be considered.



Applications without the CLEARED code word and a video link will not be reviewed.

I'm a U.S.-based business strategist and consultant who works with established entrepreneurs and service-based businesses. I'm looking for a reliable, detail-oriented assistant to help me manage a simple LinkedIn client-acquisition system.



This is not a sales or marketing strategy job. You will not be expected to figure out my marketing strategy, write complex campaigns, or sell prospective clients.



I'm looking for someone who is excellent at following a process, communicating naturally in written English, using ChatGPT, keeping track of details, and making sure prospective clients receive timely responses and follow-up.



What You'll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will include:



Using LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify potential prospects based on criteria I provide.

Reviewing prospects to make sure they meet basic qualification criteria.

Sending LinkedIn connection requests and approved outreach messages.

Logging into my LinkedIn account approximately twice each business day to monitor messages and responses.

Responding to routine messages using approved templates.

Recognizing when a message requires my personal attention and flagging it for me rather than trying to answer it yourself.

Tracking prospects through a simple spreadsheet-based pipeline.

Making sure interested prospects receive the appropriate follow-up.

Following up with people who have expressed interest but haven't yet scheduled a conversation.

Helping coordinate scheduling when necessary.

Using ChatGPT and a process I provide to help research prospects and prepare drafts of personalized strategic reviews.

Formatting and sending strategic reviews after I've approved them.

Keeping the pipeline accurate so we always know the next action for every active prospect.

What You Will NOT Be Responsible For



You will not be expected to:



Develop my marketing strategy.

Write complex marketing campaigns from scratch.

Sell or close clients.

Give business advice to prospects while pretending to be me.

Diagnose someone's business yourself.

Make strategic decisions about my offers or positioning.

Produce large amounts of social media content.



When something requires business judgment, your job is to recognize that and bring it to me.



The Person I'm Looking For



You'll probably be a great fit if:



Your written English is excellent and sounds natural, not overly formal or robotic.

You are extremely reliable and organized.

You notice details and follow instructions carefully.

You are comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools.

You have experience with LinkedIn; experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator is strongly preferred.

You can learn a defined process and then run it consistently without needing constant supervision.

You understand the importance of following up with people without being pushy.

You are comfortable working independently and asking questions when something doesn't fit the normal process.

You enjoy keeping systems organized and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



Previous experience with LinkedIn outreach, lead generation, CRM or pipeline management, or executive-assistant work would be helpful.



Hours and Schedule



This will begin as a small part-time role, approximately 5–10 hours per week.



Some of the work can be done whenever convenient, but I need someone who can check LinkedIn twice during the U.S. business day so messages don't sit unanswered for long periods.



The actual workload may be less than 10 hours per week once the system is running smoothly. I care more about getting the work done consistently and accurately than filling a particular number of hours.



There may be an opportunity for the role to grow if the relationship works well.



About Me



I'm a strategic business advisor and consultant. I've built two seven-figure businesses and have helped clients generate more than $50 million in results.



My work is primarily with experienced entrepreneurs who have reached a point where something in their business isn't working as well as it should.



I enjoy figuring out the difficult strategic problem. I'm hiring you because I don't want to spend my time managing prospect lists, sending routine messages, updating spreadsheets, and remembering who needs a follow-up.



Your role is to keep that machinery running smoothly so I can focus on the conversations and strategic thinking.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the words “Strategic Outreach” so I know you've read the complete job description.



Then please answer these four questions:



What experience do you have with LinkedIn outreach and LinkedIn Sales Navigator?

How do you currently use ChatGPT or other AI tools in your work? Please give me a specific example.

What is your hourly rate, what are your normal working hours in Philippine time, and would you be able to check LinkedIn twice during the U.S. business day?

Imagine a prospect replies to one of my messages and asks a complicated question about whether they should change their business model. What would you do?



Please keep your application relatively brief. I'm not looking for a long cover letter—I'm interested in whether you have the skills, judgment, attention to detail, and reliability this role requires.



Candidates who look like a strong fit may be invited to complete a short paid trial project before I make a final hiring decision.

title: Email Marketing & Nurture Specialist (Remote, Long-Term)
description:
About us



Bua Health is a digital healthcare provider focused on weight loss in Ireland, with plans to expand internationally. We help people access clinically appropriate weight loss care, including GLP-1 medications, through a doctor-led telehealth platform. We're small, moving fast, and we care a lot about how our brand shows up in people's inboxes.



The role



We're building a long-term
 nurture programme for people who come through our funnel and qualify for our weight loss programme but aren't ready to start on day one. Our job is to stay useful, credible, and warmly present in their inbox until they are.



We want one person to own the machinery of this programme end to end: the strategy, the content, the design, and the setup in Mailchimp. You will not be managing live campaigns day to day. What we need from you is everything up to and including the moment sequences are ready to run.



For the right person this is a long-term role. We're planning to expand the scope into social media content over time, so if you've worked on social campaigns as well, please tell us about it in your application.



What you'll do



 - Design the overall nurture strategy: segmentation, sequence architecture, cadence, goals per segment.

 - Write the
 content. Warm, clear, human, medically responsible. Never spammy and always engaging.

 - Handle the visual design. Canva is our preference, but use whatever tool you're strongest in.

 - Generate any imagery you need using Gemini.

 - Build and configure everything in Mailchimp so the sequences are ready to fire.



What we need you to be great at



 -
 nurture strategy for a considered purchase (healthcare, wellness, coaching, or similar high-trust categories).

 - Writing that reads like a real person wrote it, not a template.

 - Visual design that feels calm, premium, and healthcare-appropriate. No stock-photo clichés, no over-designed noise.

 - Mailchimp: automations, segmentation, tagging, conditional logic, and enough deliverability basics to not tank our sender reputation.



Nice to have



 - Prior work in digital health, wellness, or digital healthcare. Campaigns in those categories would be a real advantage.

 - Experience running or producing social media content, especially organic content pillars for a brand.



The AI part



We're AI-first and we expect you to be too. Use AI heavily in your workflow, for drafting, ideation, image generation with Gemini, and refinement. What we do not want is AI slop: generic openings, empty phrases, over-emojied subject lines, or bland AI-generated imagery. If you can tell the difference between a good AI-assisted
 and a lazy one, we want to talk.



How to apply



Send us:



 - A short intro (2 to 3 paragraphs, not a wall of CV) about who you are and why this fits.

 - 2 to 3 examples of
 nurture work you've done, ideally in health, wellness, or a similar considered-purchase category.

 - One example of an
 you're proud of where you used AI in the process, plus a brief note on how you used it.

 - If you have social media content experience, one or two examples of that too.

 - Your rate expectations in USD, monthly.



If you've read this far, please respond with CHICKEN in all caps at the top of your reply. We get a lot of auto-responses and this is how we find people who actually read the post.
