title: Senior Wix Studio developer for e-commerce rebuild (Catalog V3 + Velo) — Paid Trial
description:
Summary

We're rebuilding the website for a 60-year-old California wholesale distributor of tire-shop supplies, with a consumer product line for RV and dually-truck owners.



The platform and architecture are already d
: Wix Studio + Wix Stores Catalog V3 + SparkLayer for B2B pricing and account functionality.



A significant amount of the groundwork is already complete. We have the architecture, strategy documentation, initial page concepts, and product data prepared. We currently have 933 products with images, descriptions, categories, and SEO metadata loaded into our Wix Studio sandbox, along with CMS collections for customers, orders, and technical documents.



We need skilled execution by one experienced individual developer who can understand the direction we have established, work within the existing architecture, and improve the visual execution where appropriate.



The SVG mockups and page concepts we provide are starting points, not pixel-perfect final designs. We want someone who can understand the intended UX, content hierarchy, brand direction, and functionality, then use good design judgment to improve the final Wix Studio implementation.



THE WORK



* Approximately 10–20 production pages built in Wix Studio using our strategy, existing page concepts, and project requirements

* Improve and refine supplied layouts where appropriate rather than simply copying them

* Mobile breakpoint pass on every page

* Build a clean, reusable component and section pattern library

* Velo development, including server-side SEO meta tags via setMetaTags() / SSR

* Product-fitment wizard functionality

* Wix Stores Catalog V3 integration

* SparkLayer B2B integration, including wholesale pricing and account functionality

* Stripe payments

* PayPal payments

* Charge to Account / net-terms option for approved wholesale customers

* Real-time carrier shipping rates at checkout through a third-party Wix shipping app using our FedEx, UPS, and USPS carrier accounts

* Special shipping handling for oversize and FedEx-only items

* Build the site so our non-technical staff member can maintain normal content and product updates after launch without relying on a developer



SparkLayer is an important component of this project.



Prior SparkLayer experience is preferred, but not required if you have strong Wix ecommerce and Velo experience and are comfortable learning and working from SparkLayer's documentation.



HARD CONSTRAINTS



* Wix Studio only — not Harmony and not the older Wix Editor

* Wix Stores Catalog V3 only — we will reject V1 patterns

* No Custom Embeds as workarounds — use native Wix Studio components + Velo

* Work within the existing architecture rather than proposing a platform change

* Theme colors and typography are set globally in the Site Theme panel and should be referenced through theme variables rather than unnecessarily hard-coded



HOW THE ENGAGEMENT WORKS



1. PAID TRIAL FIRST — $50 FIXED PRICE



Shortlisted candidates will receive access to our Wix Studio sandbox and will build one real page.



We will provide:



* An SVG/page concept

* Brand direction

* Content

* Functional requirements

* Relevant project documentation



The supplied mockup is the starting point, not a strict pixel-for-pixel specification.



We want you to understand what the page is trying to accomplish and improve the design where you see a clear opportunity while staying consistent with the company brand, UX direction, and project architecture.



The trial includes:



* One real page built in our Wix Studio sandbox

* Desktop implementation

* Mobile breakpoint

* Clean Wix Studio structure

* Appropriate use of reusable components and patterns

* A short screen recording explaining the build

* A short demonstration showing how a non-technical staff member could edit the page



We will evaluate:



* Wix Studio proficiency

* Visual and design judgment

* Responsive implementation

* Ability to understand and improve an existing concept

* Organization of the Wix Studio build

* Ability to follow technical constraints

* Communication

* Documentation and handoff quality



Trial payment: $50 fixed price.



The paid trial is primarily intended to evaluate how you work. Completing the trial does not guarantee selection for the main project.



2. MAIN BUILD



Successful trial candidates may be offered the main project.



Estimated scope:



* Approximately 90–120 hours

* Hourly contract through the Upwork time tracker

* Approximately 10–20 production pages

* Two reasonable iteration rounds per page

* Wix Studio

* Velo

* Wix Stores Catalog V3

* SparkLayer

* CMS

* Ecommerce functionality

* Shipping integrations

* Payment configuration

* Related implementation and testing



3. POST-LAUNCH RELATIONSHIP



We would also like to maintain an ongoing hourly relationship after launch for occasional improvements, troubleshooting, and new functionality.



Expected usage would only be a few hours during a typical month.



No retainer.



INDIVIDUAL DEVELOPERS ONLY



If you are part of an agency, run an agency, or plan to subcontract any portion of this project, please do not apply.



We want one person who personally performs 100% of the work, understands the complete site, and can remain our technical contact after launch.



TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE FIVE QUESTIONS



We will not respond to applications that skip these questions or send generic/template responses.



1. Are you an individual developer or part of an agency? Will you personally perform 100% of the work?



2. Share links to 2 Wix Studio sites you personally shipped recently. Please specify exactly what you built on each project.



Studio only — not Harmony or the older Wix Editor.



3. Describe your experience with Wix Stores Catalog V3, Velo, and ecommerce integrations.



If you have worked with SparkLayer, please describe what you personally implemented.



If you have not worked with SparkLayer, tell us about a comparable B2B or ecommerce integration you personally handled.



4. Walk us through how you would implement a Velo function on a product detail page that sets SEO meta tags server-side via setMetaTags() / SSR using the product's own fields, so the tags are available to Googlebot on first load.



2–4 sentences is enough.



5. What is your hourly rate and typical engagement floor?



Please also include:



* Your time zone

* Your availability over the next 1–2 weeks

* Confirmation that you are willing to complete the $50 paid Wix Studio trial

* Confirmation that you are willing to join a live video screen-share and walk us through Wix Studio work you personally built



HOW WE SELECT



We are not selecting based on application polish.



Shortlisted developers will join a short live video call and screen-share past Wix Studio work.



Final selection will be based primarily on:



1. Relevant Wix Studio and Velo technical experience

2. Wix Stores Catalog V3 and ecommerce knowledge

3. Ability to explain work you personally built

4. Design and UX judgment

5. Paid trial performance

6. Ability to work within an established architecture

7. Communication and reliability



Short, direct answers are welcome.



English does not need to be your first language.

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

D. $250 partnership bonus when a partnership you originated or materially managed goes live AND at least $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain). An announcement or deployment with no qualifying mints does not pay

E. Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

F. No cap on appointment bonuses. One bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

G. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

H. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

WHO FITS

title: Team Leader- Risk Operations
description:
About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing organization in the financial services industry committed to maintaining the highest standards of fraud prevention, anti-money laundering (AML), and regulatory compliance. Role Overview

The Team Leader – Risk Operations will oversee the daily performance of a team of Risk Analysts responsible for fraud investigations, transaction monitoring, Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), Know Your Customer (KYC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and identity verification activities.

This role combines people leadership, operational management, and technical expertise to ensure high-quality investigations, timely case resolution, and compliance with internal policies and applicable regulatory requirements. Working closely with Compliance, Legal, Quality, Training, Product, and Technology teams, you will help strengthen financial crime controls while coaching and developing a high-performing team.

Ensure material compliance concerns and suspicious activities are properly documented and escalated.

Operational Management

Prioritize high-risk and time-sensitive investigations while maintaining service level agreements.

Monitor staffing levels, operational capacity, productivity, and case backlogs.

Participate in calibration sessions to ensure consistent application of policies and procedures.

Recommend improvements to workflows, controls, training materials, policies, and risk management tools.

Communicate procedural updates and ensure team understanding and compliance.

Support internal audits, regulatory reviews, investigations, and remediation efforts.

Provide leadership with timely updates on team performance and significant operational risks.

Technical Skills

Familiarity with risk management systems, transaction monitoring platforms, fraud detection tools, CRM platforms, and financial data solutions such as Plaid and HubSpot.

title: ACCOUNT MANAGER | AMAZON & MARKETPLACE BRANDS (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
XP Strategy manages Amazon advertising and marketplace growth for US brands. Many of our clients are seven and eight figure sellers. We handle PPC, creative, catalog, and marketplace expansion across Amazon, Walmart, and Target. Brands stay with us because we go deeper than most agencies do. We are an Amazon Ads Verified Partner with experience in AMC and DSP, plus additional marketplaces like Walmart and Target+. We are a small, senior, fully distributed team, looking to grow with A-players.



ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Account Manager, you will own a portfolio of client brands end to end. This is an ownership role, not a coordination role. You won't just send reports, relay client requests to specialists, or wait to be told what the account needs. You look at the account, understand what is actually happening, d
 what has to change, and direct the team to make it happen.



Our specialists handle bids, creative, and catalog execution. You d
 what they are executing toward. When the account grows, that is because you steered it there. When it drifts, you are the one with a plan before the client asks for one.



The job is as much personality as skill. You manage expectations against what is achievable, share the wins when things go right, and stay composed when a client is frustrated.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 3+ years of client-facing experience at an Amazon or ecommerce agency, managing multiple brands at once

- Experience with seven-figure Amazon brands and the expectations that come with them

- Strong command of Amazon PPC: campaign types, ACoS vs. TACoS, match types, ranking. Enough to challenge a specialist's plan and explain the trade-off to a brand owner, even though you are not the one adjusting bids

- Hands-on Amazon account management: product health, listing optimization, competitor tracking, pricing, reviews, inventory, launches

- Seller Central fluency. You can tell an ads problem from an account problem

- Proven track record of growing accounts, not just maintaining them

- Advanced Excel / Google Sheets. You can build a report, read it, and turn it into a recommendation someone can act on

- Experience directing cross-functional teams without formal authority over them

- Able to navigate a hard conversation professionally: deliver bad news early, hold a realistic line, stay steady under pressure

- Excellent written and spoken English, and genuinely comfortable leading video calls with US brand owners

- Organized under multi-account pressure, with project management tool experience (ClickUp, Asana, or similar)

- Nice to have: DSP exposure, Helium 10 or Data Dive, quarterly business review experience, Walmart or Target retail media, TikTok knowledge



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Client ownership (primary focus)

- Be the main point of contact for your portfolio. Every request, question, and escalation runs through you

- Set concrete targets with each client (ACoS, TACoS, revenue, launch milestones) and revisit them quarterly, monthly for accounts in active launch or peak season

- Own whether those targets get hit. Specialists execute, you steer and course-correct when the numbers drift

- Run onboarding end to end: kickoff call, access collection, expectation setting, and KPI baselines inside the first 30 days



Quality control (the standard we're strictest about)

- Nothing reaches a client until you have checked it against the target it was supposed to move. Not a report, not a strategy doc, not a bulk change

- You are the last line of defense on work that carries our name



Cross-functional direction (without direct reports)

- Drive execution across the PPC, creative, and catalog teams: set priorities and deadlines, give clear feedback, keep everyone aligned on what matters this month

- Be the internal voice of the client. Escalate resourcing conflicts early rather than absorbing them quietly



Communication and retention

- Keep a steady rhythm: weekly written updates, monthly report calls, quarterly business reviews, always framed in business terms like revenue, profitability, and TACoS

- Come to every call with an agenda, insights, and next steps. Flag stockouts, listing issues, and seasonality before the client notices

- Watch for early warning signs (a spend or revenue trend that breaks, two consecutive target misses, a champion leaving, invoices slowing, replies getting shorter) and act within days

- Handle unhappy-client situations directly: acknowledge fast, find the root cause with the team, come back with a specific fix and a date



Growth

- Know each brand well enough to see what is next: a new marketplace, additional ASINs, a second brand, a service they don't have yet, and bring it as a real proposal

- Keep ClickUp current so anyone can open an account and know exactly where it stands



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AFTER A YEAR

- Your clients are still your clients, and they would take a reference call for us

- Several have grown with us: a new marketplace, more brands, expanded scope

- Every account has had four real business reviews, not four rescheduled ones

- Your specialists know what matters on each account without asking twice

- Nothing has reached a client that embarrassed us



SCHEDULE

Fully remote. Semi-flexible schedule with substantial overlap required with US Eastern business hours. Client calls happen on their clock.



SALARY

$1,250 to $2,500 per month, depending on experience.

Read this post fully, then complete our short application form. It includes a quick 2-minute video intro where you speak as though you are talking to a client.

title: BILLING SUPPORT SPECIALIST - Mental Health Industry
description:
BILLING SUPPORT SPECIALIST



We are looking for an A-Player.



Reports to: Lead Biller, Credentialing Coordinator, and/or Executive Director

Position type: Part-time or full-time, based on organizational need



Organization: Wings of the Future



Position Summary

Wings of the Future is seeking a dependable, detail-oriented Billing Support Specialist to support day-to-day billing operations and provide backup coverage for provider credentialing. This role works closely with the Lead Biller, credentialing staff, leadership, providers, and administrative tea
mbers to improve claim accuracy, reduce preventable delays, support timely reimbursement, and maintain complete, audit-ready records.



A central responsibility of this position is the accurate setup and maintenance of clients’ primary and secondary insurance coverage. The successful candidate must be able to build insurance profiles in the billing system, confirm coordination of benefits, determine correct payer order, and support proper submission of primary and secondary claims.



Role purpose: Provide accurate, timely billing support and dependable credentialing backup—not replace the Lead Biller or Credentialing Coordinator.



Essential Duties and Responsibilities



1. Primary and Secondary Insurance Setup and Coordination



• Build, update, and maintain primary and secondary insurance profiles in the billing system and/or electronic health record.

• Accurately enter payer names, member and group numbers, plan types, effective and termination dates, subscriber information, relationship to subscriber, claims addresses, payer IDs, and other required fields.

• Verify which coverage is primary and which is secondary using payer information and coordination-of-benefits requirements; do not guess when payer order is unclear.

• Confirm active coverage, benefits, patient responsibility, authorization requirements, and payer-specific billing rules before claims are submitted.

• Update coordination-of-benefits information and flag coverage conflicts, inactive policies, duplicate coverage, or missing information for prompt resolution.

• Support correct sequencing of primary and secondary claims, including submission of required primary-payer remittance information to the secondary payer.

• Track crossover claims and manually submit secondary claims when automatic crossover does not occur.

• Help prevent duplicate billing, incorrect payer billing, untimely filing, and avoidable denials related to insurance setup or payer order.



2. Claim Preparation and Submission Support



• Prepare, review, batch, submit, and track claims under the direction of the Lead Biller.

• Check client demographics, insurance details, payer information, rendering and billing provider data, dates of service, CPT/HCPCS codes, ICD-10 codes, modifiers, units, place of service, authorizations, and other required claim elements.

• Identify missing, incomplete, inconsistent, or incorrect information before claim submission.

• Follow payer-specific requirements, internal billing workflows, and timely-filing deadlines.

• Maintain accurate claim logs, billing records, and supporting documentation.



3. Documentation and Billing Readiness



• Confirm that required service notes, signatures, dates, treatment plans, assessments, authorizations, service logs, and other billing documentation are present.

• Track outstanding documentation and promptly notify the appropriate staff member when records are missing or incomplete.

• Identify basic documentation gaps that may delay or prevent billing without replacing clinical supervision or clinical review.



4. Eligibility and Authorization Support



• Verify insurance eligibility and benefits at intake and as required throughout service delivery.

• Maintain authorization numbers, approved dates, units, service types, expiration dates, and payer-specific requirements.

• Alert the Lead Biller and appropriate leadership when an authorization is missing, incorrect, exhausted, or nearing expiration.

• Review payer portals and communicate payer-related concerns as directed.

5. Payment Posting, Reconciliation, and Accounts Receivable



• Post or assist with posting payments, adjustments, and patient responsibility accurately in the billing system.

• Review EOBs, ERAs, payment reports, and payer portals; match payments to claims and accounts.

• Identify unpaid claims, underpayments, overpayments, recoupments, adjustments, and other discrepancies for review.

• Support monthly reconciliation, accounts-receivable tracking, aging review, and billing-report preparation.



6. Denial, Rejection, and Claim Follow-Up



• Track denied, rejected, unpaid, pending, and delayed claims, including primary and secondary claims.

• Research denial reasons, correct basic claim errors as directed, and prepare corrected claims or resubmissions.

• Gather records needed for reconsiderations, appeals, medical-necessity review, or payer follow-up.

• Identify recurring denial patterns and escalate trends that may require workflow, documentation, credentialing, or payer-contract corrections.



7. Credentialing and Payer Enrollment Backup



• Provide backup support for provider credentialing, recredentialing, payer enrollment, and roster maintenance.

• Collect and organize licenses, liability insurance, NPI and taxonomy information, CAQH records, resumes, certifications, board information, W-9 forms, background checks, and other payer-required documents.

• Track application status, payer effective dates, approval dates, follow-up deadlines, and provider participation status.

• Monitor expiration dates and follow up on missing, outdated, or incomplete provider documents.

• Assist with CAQH updates and attestations, NPI information, payer applications, portal activity, and credentialing logs when authorized.

• Maintain secure, complete, accurate, and audit-ready provider credentialing files.

• Support credentialing coverage when the primary credentialing tea
mber is unavailable.



8. Communication, Compliance, and Record Maintenance



• Provide timely status updates, document completed work, and ask questions whenever instructions or payer rules are unclear.

• Communicate professionally with staff, providers, payer representatives, and credentialing departments as authorized.

• Maintain accurate client billing profiles, payer records, electronic files, spreadsheets, and tracking logs.

• Follow HIPAA, privacy, security, billing, credentialing, documentation, and organizational compliance requirements.

• Protect client, provider, insurance, credentialing, clinical, and financial information at all times.

• Report suspected errors, inconsistencies, privacy concerns, or compliance issues promptly; never make unauthorized changes to records.

Required Qualifications



• Demonstrated ability to build and maintain primary and secondary insurance coverage in a billing system or electronic health record.

• Working knowledge of coordination of benefits, payer order, primary-to-secondary claim sequencing, EOB/ERA review, and secondary claim submission.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and deadline management.

• Ability to protect confidential information and consistently follow HIPAA and organizational privacy requirements.

• Professional written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to follow detailed procedures, learn payer requirements, work independently, accept feedback, and ask for clarification rather than guess.

• Comfort using billing software, electronic health records, spreadsheets,
, payer portals, and online credentialing systems.

Preferred Qualifications



• Experience in behavioral health, mental health, medical, Medicaid, managed-care, private-insurance, or nonprofit healthcare billing.

• Experience with claim submission, payment posting, accounts receivable, denial management, corrected claims, appeals, and reconciliation.

• Knowledge of CPT/HCPCS codes, ICD-10 codes, modifiers, service units, authorizations, and timely-filing requirements.

• Experience with provider credentialing, payer enrollment, CAQH, NPI, taxonomy codes, roster maintenance, or credentialing file management.

• Experience reviewing EOBs, ERAs, payer portals, credentialing portals, and aging reports.

Core Competencies



• Reliable, accurate, organized, ethical, and consistent.

• Calm under pressure and able to manage repetitive, detail-heavy work.

• Respectful, accountable, receptive to coaching, and committed to correcting errors promptly.

• Able to manage billing and credentialing priorities without losing track of deadlines or confidential information.

• Aligned with Wings of the Future’s mission and commitment to integrity, service, and sustainable care.

Typical Daily and Weekly Activities



• Build or update primary and secondary insurance profiles and resolve coordination-of-benefits questions.

• Verify eligibility, benefits, payer order, and authorization status.

• Review claims and documentation for billing readiness; update billing logs.

• Track primary claims, secondary claims, crossover status, denials, rejections, and unpaid balances.

• Post payments, review remittance information, and support reconciliation and aging follow-up.

• Update credentialing trackers, follow up on missing provider documents, and monitor expirations.

• Attend billing or credentialing check-ins and complete assigned tasks by deadline.

Performance Expectations and Success Measures



• Accurate setup and maintenance of primary and secondary insurance records.

• Correct payer sequencing and fewer preventable claim errors or denials related to insurance setup.

• Timely completion of claims, follow-up tasks, credentialing assignments, and documentation reviews.

• Reduced billing backlog and faster identification of missing information.

• Organized, current, and audit-ready billing and credentialing records.

• Clear communication, consistent confidentiality, dependable attendance, strong follow-through, and steady growth in billing, payer, credentialing, and organizational workflow knowledge.

Training and Supervision



The Lead Biller, Credentialing Coordinator, and/or leadership will provide training on the organization’s systems, workflows, documentation standards, payer procedures, claim submission, denial tracking, payment posting, credentialing requirements, and confidentiality expectations. The employee is expected to take notes, follow established procedures, ask questions, incorporate feedback, and become increasingly independent as competency is demonstrated.



Confidentiality



This position has access to sensitive client, clinical, provider, insurance, credentialing, and financial information. Strict confidentiality and compliance with all applicable privacy laws, ethical standards, payer requirements, and organizational policies are conditions of employment. A breach of confidentiality or intentional falsification of billing or credentialing information may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination.



Mission Alignment



Accurate billing and credentialing allow Wings of the Future to remain financially stable, support its providers, serve clients, and expand services for individuals and families in need. This position plays an essential behind-the-scenes role in helping the organization operate with excellence, integrity, and sustainability.



Equal Opportunity Statement



Wings of the Future is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.



How to Apply



Please submit a resume, portfolio/a brief statement describing your billing experience, your experience building primary and secondary insurance coverage, your familiarity with coordination of benefits and secondary claims, any credentialing or payer-enrollment experience, and your interest in supporting Wings of the Future.

title: Amazon PPC Manager
description:
As a growing Amazon agency in Europe, we are seeking a skilled and experienced Amazon PPC Advertising Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and optimizing PPC campaigns for several Amazon accounts, driving sales growth and maximizing ROI. We are definitely looking for a long-term hire!



This isn't just a job; it's a dream come true for anyone passionate about online marketing, offering attractive pay, boundless growth potential, and a platform to showcase your exceptional talent. Your contributions will directly impact our growth, and your efforts will be recognized and rewarded.

Plus, you'll collaborate with a team of bright, motivated individuals, all dedicated to revolutionizing the Amazon market.



We value experience, but even more so, we're looking for someone with a sharp intellect, a solid work ethic, and an eagerness to learn and innovate.



Key Responsibilities:



- Develop and manage PPC strategies for various Amazon accounts.

- Conduct thorough keyword research and analysis to optimize ad campaigns.

- Monitor and adjust bids, budgets, and performance metrics to achieve desired targets.

- Analyze campaign performance data to identify trends and insights for continuous improvement.

- Collaborate with the team to integrate PPC strategies with overall marketing goals.

- Stay up-to-date with Amazon's advertising policies and industry best practices.

- Prepare special deals like Prime days, Black Fridays,...

- Onboard new clients and tailor a custom strategy for each one

- You will be in charge of at least 10 Amazon Accounts, where each Account has between 5-100 products. --> So only apply if you have handled such amount of accounts and products before!

- You know how to take an Amazon Account from 50k revenue per month to 150k.

- Your performance will be directly measured by our clients' results. So make sure you know what you are doing ;)



Qualifications:

- Proven experience in managing Amazon PPC campaigns with demonstrable success.

- You worked for an Amazon agency before as an PPC Manager

- 3 years of experience in PPC is a MUST!

- Advanced understanding of Amazon's advertising platform and PPC best practices.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills in English

- Detail-oriented with strong organizational and project management abilities.

- Proficiency in relevant tools and software (Helium 10; Data Dive,...)



Why Join Us:

- Be part of a dynamic and growing team. We have multiple VA's working for us from the PH.

- We value you and your personal growth.

- Opportunity to work on diverse projects with significant impact.

- Competitive salary and benefits.

- A supportive and collaborative work environment.

- Full-Remote

- We are definitely looking for a long-term hire!





Application Process:



Send us a one-page letter telling us why you would be a good fit for this job.

Interested candidates should submit a resume, cover letter, and examples of previous successful Amazon work.

Include "Amazon PPC Manager" in the headline of your response.

Great jobs like this come along once in a lifetime. Don’t let this one slip by.





Only apply if you are a real Amazon expert. No newbies on this job.

40h / week. No part time or freelancers.



Can't wait to see your application and hopefully work together!

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION



Please read the full post before applying. Experienced ecommerce ad creators only.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a fast-scaling health, beauty, and wellness dropshipping company running Meta ads. We need an experienced Image Ad Creator who can turn briefs and competitor swipes into high-converting static image ads for
 and Instagram.



This is a long-term, full-time remote role on our creative team. Working hours are flexible, but you must be available to work on weekends when required by the creative schedule.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Create static image ads for
 and Instagram in the health, beauty, and wellness niche.

- Work from creative briefs and competitor swipes to produce ad variations with different hooks, angles, and offers.

- Design scroll-stopping visuals such as benefit callouts, offer graphics, testimonial images, and compliant before-and-after style creatives.

- Follow our brand style and deliver clean, consistent output at good volume and speed.

- Keep every ad compliant with Meta's health and beauty rules so we avoid rejections.

- Work with the creative strategist and media buying team, and revise quickly based on feedback and rejected ads.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Proven experience making static image ads for dropshipping or DTC ecommerce brands. Health and beauty experience is a big plus.

- You can take a brief or a competitor swipe and turn it into an effective image ad.

- Strong understanding of Meta ad compliance for health and beauty (what gets ads rejected, such as aggressive claims, cure or treatment claims, unrealistic timelines, and risky before-and-after content) and how to design around it.

- Proficient in Canva. 

- Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and a clear communicator.

- Available full-time and for long-term cooperation.

- Comfortable working flexible hours, including weekends when needed.



NICE TO HAVE



- Health, beauty, or wellness ad experience.

- Advertorial and offer graphic experience.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word CREATIVE so we know you read the full post.



Then answer the questions below clearly. Real examples and your portfolio matter far more than general statements.



1. How many years have you made static image ads for ecommerce or dropshipping brands?

2. Have you made ads in the health, beauty, or wellness niche? Please share examples.

title: Change Management Manager
description:
About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing organization looking for a Change Management Manager who can lead organizational change while driving quality, training, and operational excellence across the business. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys bringing structure to ambiguity, and is passionate about helping teams successfully adopt new processes, tools, and ways of working.

Role Overview

The Change Management Manager will lead organizational change initiatives while overseeing Quality Assurance and Training functions across the organization. This role is responsible for ensuring teams are prepared, supported, and equipped to successfully adopt new processes, improve performance, and maintain high-quality standards.

Working cross-functionally, you will develop scalable change management strategies, improve employee readiness, and ensure organizational changes are effectively communicated, implemented, and sustained.

Key Responsibilities

Change Management

Lead change management initiatives for new processes, systems, tools, and organizational updates.

Develop and execute change management strategies that drive successful adoption across the business.

Create communication and stakeholder engagement plans to ensure smooth transitions.

Monitor adoption rates, gather feedback, and continuously improve change initiatives.

Partner with cross-functional leaders to standardize processes and document best practices.

Quality Assurance & Performance

Lead and manage the QA Analysts and Trainers to maintain high-quality standards across Retention and Support teams.

Develop and maintain QA frameworks, scorecards, and performance metrics.

Partner with the QA team to conduct audits, identify trends, and implement effective coaching plans.

Ensure QA insights are translated into actionable improvements across the organization.

Training & Development

Own the organization's training strategy, including onboarding and ongoing employee development.

Ensure new hires become productive quickly through structured learning programs.

Align training initiatives with QA findings and organizational changes.

Build scalable learning resources that support long-term employee success.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with leadership and operational teams to align change initiatives with business objectives.

Build scalable systems and processes that support organizational growth.

Foster collaboration and alignment across departments to ensure successful execution of change initiatives.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in Change Management, People Operations, HR Operations, Organizational Development, Learning & Development, or a related leadership role.

Experience leading cross-functional change initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

Strong understanding of change management methodologies and organizational development principles.

Experience managing QA, Training, or Operational Excellence teams is highly preferred.

Proven ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.

Excellent communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.

Experience building scalable processes and operational frameworks.

Who Thrives Here

Leaders who connect change management initiatives to measurable business outcomes.

Professionals who embrace ambiguity and adapt quickly to changing priorities.

Influential communicators who can build consensus without relying on authority.

Data-driven problem solvers who use insights to improve organizational performance.

Coaches who enjoy developing people and building high-performing teams.

Process builders who create scalable, sustainable solutions rather than one-time fixes.

Success Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

Increased adoption of new processes, systems, and tools.

Improved employee engagement and retention.

Consistent improvement in QA scores.

Faster ramp-up time for new hires.

Positive feedback from team leads and cross-functional stakeholders regarding the effectiveness of change initiatives.

Increased compliance with standardized processes across the organization.

Why Join Our Client

Play a key role in driving organizational transformation within a growing company.

Lead strategic initiatives that directly impact employee success and business performance.

Collaborate with cross-functional leaders in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Build scalable programs and processes that create lasting organizational impact.

This version positions the role as a true Change Management Manager, with QA and Training reporting into the change function rather than being the primary focus. It aligns well with market expectations for similar roles.

title: Graphic Designer for Amazon Content (Project-Based, Remote)
description:
About us & the role

We're Threesy, a young and fast-growing Amazon agency based in Vienna, Austria. We help companies of all sizes build lasting success on Amazon. You can find out more at 



This role is 100% remote. We work across time zones and our processes are built for it.



On Amazon, the images d
 whether a product sells. As our Graphic Designer, you create them — and you see what your work does for our clients in real numbers. You'll be working on German-market listings, but you don't need to speak German: our team writes and approves all copy, you bring the visual craft.



What you'll do



Amazon content: You design main images, image galleries, A+ Content and Brand Stores for our clients — from first concept to final asset.

Ad creatives: You produce the visuals for Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display campaigns.

AI as a tool: You work with the current AI tools (Claude Design, Nano Banana, ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly and others) to get more out of your time. You enjoy building the templates and workflows that save you manual work.

Volume without losing quality: From one approved concept, you build twenty clean variants. Consistency across a whole catalog is part of the job.

Test & learn: We run Amazon experiments. You'll see which variant won and carry that into the next projects.

Startup mindset: Some tasks come up during the day. You'll be involved flexibly and get to know different areas of the business.



What you should bring



Design experience: At least 2 years, ideally in e-commerce, advertising or packaging. Amazon experience is a plus, not a must.

Technical craft: You know which tools do the job best and you're fast in them.

Good English: Written and spoken. You need to understand briefings precisely and ask when something is unclear.

Comfortable with AI: You already work with AI image tools and have a real sense of where they hold up and where they don't.

Reasoning behind your choices: You can explain why a design works. Here it's about buying behavior, not taste.

Remote experience: You work independently, without anyone looking over your shoulder, and you communicate clearly and reliably.

Attention to detail: Product photos have to show the actual product. Typography in a language you don't speak means you check twice, not once.



What we offer



100% remote, permanently: No office requirement. Work from wherever you work well.

Core hours 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM Manila time (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM Vienna). The rest of your day is yours to structure.

A long-term partnership: We're not looking for a one-off gig. We want someone who grows with us over years and gets to know our clients.

Short paths: You talk directly to the founders. No layers, no long approval loops. Good ideas get done.

Budget for AI tools & training: We'll get you whatever you need to be the person on the team who knows these tools best.

Growth & responsibility: We're growing fast and you can genuinely shape how design works here.



Compensation

This is a project-based role. You can earn up to 1,200 USD per month, depending on your experience, your speed and the volume of work coming in.



To be upfront about it: the workload isn't identical every month. Busy months hit the upper end, quieter months will be less. If you need a fixed guaranteed monthly income, this role isn't the right fit — but if you're comfortable with project work and want a reliable long-term client who pays on time, we'd like to hear from you. We'll always tell you early what the coming weeks look like.



Sounds good?

Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph only. Please don't
 us or contact us on other platforms — we only review applications that come through this listing.



Send us your portfolio and two or three sentences on why this role. Start your message with your favorite AI image tool and why you use it, so we know you actually read this. Put "Graphic Designer" in your headline so we know you read this.



We reply within one business day. After that: a 10-minute call, a test task on a real listing, then a decision. Two weeks maximum.



We're looking forward to hearing from you!

title: SEO Specialist with Wordpress and GEO experience
description:
Job Overview:



We are seeking a dedicated, results-oriented Search Engine Optimization (SEO) specialist based in the Philippines for a full-time remote role. You will manage traditional SEO alongside Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)—optimizing content so AI-driven engines (e.g., ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity) can easily discover, interpret, cite, and include it in generated responses—for our clients, primarily US-based small to medium businesses in niches like home services, local professionals, and e-commerce. You'll also perform hands-on changes and updates directly on WordPress websites.



This is a long-term opportunity with room for growth, performance-based raises, and bonuses tied to measurable outcomes like improved search rankings, AI citations, traffic growth, and lead generation.



Key Responsibilities:



Conduct on-page Search Engine Optimization (SEO): keyword research, optimizing meta titles/descriptions, headings, alt text, internal linking, and implementing schema markup (using plugins like Yoast or Rank Math).

Apply Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) techniques: structure content with authoritative language, unique phrasing, statistics/quotes, fluent explanations, and entity optimization to increase visibility and citations in AI-generated answers.

Optimize content for both traditional search engines and generative AI: rewrite pages for clarity, add persuasive elements, ensure E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness), and test for AI pickup using tools like ChatGPT or Perplexity.

Perform direct WordPress edits and management: log in to client sites, install/update plugins, create/edit pages and posts, optimize images/content, resolve basic issues, and make customizations using page builders (Elementor, Divi, etc.—no advanced coding required, but familiarity helps).

Support off-page efforts: basic link building, directory submissions, and collaborations to boost domain authority for better AI recognition.

Monitor and report monthly performance: track rankings (Google Search Console), traffic (Google Analytics 4), AI citations (via manual checks or tools), and leads generated.

Communicate professionally via Slack, Asana / Trello, and occasional quick calls (some overlap with US Eastern/Central time preferred, but flexible).



Required Skills & Experience:



1–3+ years of practical experience in Search Engine Optimization (SEO), with exposure to or strong interest in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for AI-driven platforms.

Solid WordPress proficiency: comfortable making backend/frontend changes, using SEO plugins, page builders, and basic troubleshooting.

Familiarity with key tools: Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Ahrefs/SEMrush (access provided if needed), plus AI testing tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Claude.

Leadership, strong work ethics, English communication skills (written and spoken) for client-facing updates and creating AI-optimized content.

Proactive, detail-focused, able to work independently while following clear guidelines.

Bonus (helpful but not mandatory): Experience with content structuring for LLMs, E-E-A-T optimization, basic HTML/CSS tweaks, or tools like Surfer SEO/Semrush Content Editor.

What We Offer



Full-time commitment: 40 hours/week (flexible scheduling with some US time-zone overlap ideal).

Starting monthly salary:
php(based on your experience and demonstrated skills; we start at the lower end and raise quickly with proven results).

Performance bonuses (e.g., for achieving ranking improvements, AI citation increases, or lead goals).

Paid time off and long-term stability with potential to advance to handling multiple clients or a senior role.

Tools and subscriptions provided (Ahrefs, etc.) after initial probation.

Supportive team environment—no excessive micromanagement if you deliver quality work.



How to Apply Please reply with or send an
 to

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Sales Development Representative

(Sparkblaze Digital)



Location: Remote (Work from Home) / Hybrid

Salary: PHP 20,000 - PHP 60,000/month DOE (Depending on Experience) + Commission/Incentives

Employment Type: Full-time

Work Schedule: Eastern Standard Time (EST) or Flexible - Monday to Friday



About Sparkblaze Digital



Sparkblaze Digital is a full-service digital marketing agency dedicated to helping startups and growing businesses ignite growth with innovative, results-driven strategies. Our team builds and manages data-driven campaigns — from paid advertising and SEO to landing pages and conversion rate optimization — that generate measurable ROI for our clients.



We work across a wide range of industries, including e-commerce, B2B, SaaS, finance, real estate, home services, and local businesses, helping each one scale smarter and grow faster with tailored strategies. We are a fully remote team transitioning to a hybrid set-up, and we are looking for experienced, high-performing talent to help accelerate our agency's growth.



What You'll Do



As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will own the top-of-funnel of Sparkblaze Digital's sales pipeline. Your primary focus is prospecting, qualifying, and nurturing leads, then booking well-prepped discovery calls for our closing team — setting them up to convert qualified prospects into long-term agency clients. You act as the critical bridge between our marketing/intake team and our sales closers.



Your responsibilities may include:



- Prospecting and identifying potential clients who match our ideal buyer profile, primarily within the education, consulting, and other B2B service industries.

- Qualifying inbound leads generated by our marketing campaigns, and conducting outbound outreach (calls,
, and messaging) to build a healthy pipeline.

- Researching each prospect's business and current online presence to understand their needs before outreach, so conversations are relevant and informed.

- Nurturing warm leads over time through consistent, personalized follow-up until they're ready for a deeper sales conversation.

- Booking discovery calls and qualified meetings for the closing team, and preparing clear handoff notes on each prospect's needs, budget, and goals.

- Accurately logging all prospect interactions, pipeline stages, and lead details in the CRM system to keep data current for the wider sales team.

- Collaborating closely with the marketing and intake teams to ensure lead quality, timely follow-through, and a smooth handoff process.

- Using CRM and AI-assisted tools to prioritize high-potential accounts and streamline outreach.

- Contributing insights from prospect conversations to help refine messaging, targeting, and outreach strategy.

- Meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly targets for qualified meetings booked and pipeline generated.



What Are We Looking For?



We are looking for a driven top-of-funnel specialist with a genuine interest in digital marketing and paid media. You don't need to be a closer — you need to be excellent at opening doors, qualifying opportunities, and setting our sales team up to win.



You should have:



- This role is also open to fresh graduates. Individuals who graduated a 4-year degree course with 1–3 years of experience as a Sales Development Representative (SDR), appointment setter, business development representative (BDR), or similar prospecting and lead-qualification role — agency or digital marketing experience is a plus.

- Comfort with outbound prospecting (cold calling,
ing, and social outreach) as well as qualifying inbound leads.

- A working understanding of paid advertising concepts (Meta Ads, Google Ads, and sales funnels) to speak credibly with prospects.

- Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or similar) for logging activity, tracking pipeline, and reporting.

- Strong research skills — able to review a prospect's online footprint and identify relevant marketing gaps ahead of a call.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills for building rapport quickly and asking effective qualifying questions.

- Persistence and resilience — comfortable with rejection and consistent, disciplined follow-up.

- Familiarity with video conferencing and communication tools (e.g., Zoom, Slack) for booking and coordinating meetings.



Who Are We Looking For?



We are looking for A-players — individuals who are hungry, curious, and take full ownership of their pipeline goals.



- A Proactive Prospector: Doesn't wait for leads to arrive — actively researches and reaches out to build a strong pipeline.

- A Skilled Qualifier: Asks the right questions to quickly determine fit and surface a prospect's real needs.

- Highly Self-Disciplined: Manages a daily outreach workflow independently, without requiring constant micro-management.

- Persistent & Resilient: Keeps picking up the phone and following up, even after rejection.

- Coachable: Takes feedback well and continuously refines their outreach and qualifying approach.

- Organized & Disciplined: Detail-oriented and highly reliable in logging pipeline data and tracking follow-ups.

- Curious & Growth-Oriented: Stays on top of industry trends and is eager to grow into a closing or leadership role over time.

- A Strong Collaborator: Works closely with marketing and closers alike to keep the pipeline moving smoothly.



Why Join Sparkblaze Digital



- Remote Flexibility: Fully remote work setup with a fixed and consistent schedule.

- Competitive Pay: A competitive base salary paired with performance incentives.

- High-Performance Culture: Opportunity to work directly with a results-driven digital marketing team.

- Inbound Lead Support: Benefit from a dedicated intake and marketing framework that feeds your pipeline.

- Fast Career Growth: A clear pathway from SDR into closing or sales leadership roles as the department scales.

- Supportive Environment: A skill-focused, collaborative work setup built for high achievers.



If you're an organized, persistent communicator who loves the hunt of prospecting and qualifying leads — and you're excited to grow your career in digital marketing sales — we'd love to hear from you.



Apply now and kick-start your sales career with Sparkblaze Digital.

title: Track and Trace Assistant
description:
GH Logistics is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, on track, and moving cleanly from pickup to delivery. If you’re someone who enjoys staying engaged, solving live challenges, and being part of a fast moving operations team, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

As a Track & Trace Assistant, you serve as part of the operational backbone, ensuring shipments are accurately monitored, risks are identified early, and critical information reaches the right people at the right time. if you thrive behind the scenes keeping operations running smoothly, this role is an excellent fit.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Updating assigned sections of the Tracking Dashboard with accurate ETAs, locations, mileage, and notes

• Communicating with carriers via
 and internal channels to gather updates or resolve missing information

• Verifying that carriers are properly assigned, accepted, and actively tracking in required platforms

• Monitoring multiple communication channels to prevent missed updates

• Proactively flagging delays, risks, and irregularities, and escalating when necessary

• Coordinating with the Booking Team to confirm ETAs for time sensitive shipments

• Ensuring clean shift handoffs through verbal (Zoom) and written updates

• Follows instructions consistently and executes with precision

• Team oriented, coachable, and open to feedback without ego

• Minimum of 45 words per minute



What Success Looks Like

• Assigned tracking sections are consistently accurate and up to date

• Scheduled updates are sent on time

• Critical shipments are monitored closely and handled with urgency from start to finish

• Carrier tracking and acceptance issues are caught early

• Issues are communicated clearly, both verbally and in writing

• Shift handoffs are smooth, complete, and well documented



Who We’re Looking For

• Has experience in US logistics, freight brokerage, or track & trace

• Familiar with US geography and US logistics trucking operations (a plus)

• Highly organized and comfortable working with multiple spreadsheets, dashboards, and group chats

• Understands urgency and prioritization in a live freight environment

• Communicates clearly and professionally via chat and

• Can monitor multiple shipments at once without losing accuracy

• Pays strong attention to detail and uses sound judgment when issues arise

• Follows instructions consistently and values clean processes

• Works well with a team and is open to feedback and coaching. Collaborates without resistance or ego



Why Join GH Logistics?

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Structured systems and clear expectations

• Hands on leadership and direct feedback

• Defined KPIs and measurable growth

• Opportunity to grow within a scaling freight brokerage

• Performance based advancement



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full Time Remote Role| Direct Hire to US Company

• Current Shift Availability: Saturday - Wednesday 6 AM - 3 PM CDT | Monday - Friday 9 PM - 6 AM CDT | Friday - Tuesday 8 PM - 5 AM CDT | Sunday - Thursday 3 PM - 12 AM CDT

• Zoom presence (with camera open) required

• Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support



This role is built for someone who genuinely enjoys following freight in motion, monitoring shipments, confirming updates, and making sure deliveries stay on track. If you like staying proactive, spotting risks before they become problems, and keeping operations running smoothly behind the scenes, you’ll fit right in.

title: Trailer Management Admin (Urgent)
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Sunday - Friday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT | Tuesday - Sunday 10 AM - 8 PM CDT

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Possible Hubstaff time tracking during shifts, but is not currently in use.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who can recognize trailer issues, coordinate repairs, follow up consistently, and ensure equipment returns to service as quickly as possible

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

• Candidates who are unfamiliar with trailer maintenance concerns or are uncomfortable coordinating repairs and operational solutions



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, properly repaired, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, problem-solving, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

Dominion Financial Services (DFS) is a nationally recognized private lender dedicated to supporting real estate investors. With a focus on Short-Term Bridge Loans and Long-Term Rental Loans, DFS empowers clients to scale their businesses and build lasting generational wealth. DFS stands out as a leader, consistently achieving strong, measurable growth quarter after quarter.



At Dominion, we are committed to building a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. title: Funnel Specialist
description:
About The Visionary Group (TVG)



Welcome to The Visionary Group. We are a close knit e-commerce growth team of brand builders, strategists, and marketers. We help companies scale to maximum their true potential by exploring DTC solutions best suit for their stage of business. Founded in 2022, our collection of fast paced tea
mbers is becoming filled with high priority work, which is where you come in!



What this position is responsible for:



We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. This role exists to bridge the gap between paid acquisition and on-site conversion performance, ensuring traffic generated by our Paid Media Strategists converts at the highest possible rate. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands.



Requirements/Experience:



- 2+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), DTC eCommerce, funnel optimization, or Shopify growth operations



- Strong working knowledge of Shopify and DTC customer acquisition funnels



- Experience using tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics platforms



- Hands-on experience building and updating landing pages and pre-sale pages using Replo or similar no-code builders



- Familiarity with quiz funnel platforms such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, or related tools



- Experience implementing and analyzing A/B tests using tools like Convert, GLO, Intelligems, or equivalent testing platforms



- Strong understanding of key eCommerce conversion metrics including LP CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, and funnel conversion flow



- Ability to write high-converting CRO-focused copy including headlines, CTAs, benefit-driven bullets, and trust-building messaging



- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on impact and effort



- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client funnels simultaneously



- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Paid Media Strategists and internal stakeholders



- High attention to detail and strong bias toward execution and accountability



- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment



Roles & Responsibilities for this position:



- Conduct monthly audits of each client’s full acquisition funnel, including the transition from ad creative to landing page/PDP, add-to-cart flow, checkout experience, and post-purchase confirmation journey



- Analyze funnel performance data using GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and related tools to identify drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities



- Develop and maintain a prioritized “funnel fix queue” for each client based on projected revenue lift, implementation effort, and business impact



- Collaborate closely with Paid Media Strategists to identify and communicate systemic funnel issues, including disconnects between ad messaging and landing page experience



- Build, launch, and optimize pre-sale pages in Replo to support paid acquisition campaigns and improve conversion performance



- Create, update, and maintain quiz funnels using tools such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, and similar platforms

Implement updates to product detail pages (PDPs) using Shopify-native apps and templated modules without requiring custom Liquid development



- Launch and optimize landing pages designed specifically for paid traffic campaigns and conversion-focused customer journeys



- Execute structured A/B testing initiatives using platforms such as Convert, GLO, or Intelligems, ensuring proper setup, tracking, and reporting



- Write and refine conversion-focused copy for headlines, subheads, product bullets, CTAs, badges, and other on-site conversion elements
