title: Part-Time B2B Sales & Appointment-Setting Virtual Assistant
description:
**Part-Time B2B Sales & Appointment-Setting Virtual Assistant**



Recruiting on Social is looking for a proactive, organized and persuasive Sales and Appointment-Setting Virtual Assistant to help us build relationships with prospective clients and place qualified decision-makers on our founder’s calendar.



This is not a general administrative VA position. Your primary responsibility will be generating qualified conversations with organizations that may need support with workforce strategy, hiring, employee development, leadership, workplace culture and professional training.



**Primary responsibilities**



* Research organizations that match our ideal client profile.

* Identify HR, talent, people, operations, learning and executive decision-makers.

* Add and accurately maintain contacts, companies, notes and activity in HubSpot.

* Conduct personalized outreach through
 and LinkedIn.

* Invite qualified prospects to webinars, workshops and information sessions.

* Follow up with webinar registrants before and after each event.

* Ask preliminary qualification questions before scheduling sales calls.

* Schedule qualified prospects directly on the founder’s calendar.

* Confirm appointments and follow up with no-shows.

* Maintain an organized pipeline with clear next steps for every active lead.

* Submit a concise weekly report covering activity, replies, appointments, attendance and pipeline opportunities.



**What success looks like**



Success is not measured by sending large volumes of generic messages. Success means consistently creating genuine conversations and scheduling meetings with relevant, interested decision-makers.



A qualified appointment must:



* Match our target market.

* Include an appropriate decision-maker or purchasing influencer.

* Have a relevant workforce, hiring, leadership or training need.

* Understand that the meeting will explore a potentially paid service.

* Attend the scheduled appointment.



**Preferred qualifications**



* Previous experience in B2B appointment setting, lead generation, sales development or outbound sales.

* Experience using HubSpot or a similar CRM.

* Strong written and spoken English.

* Ability to research organizations and identify the correct decision-makers.

* Professional, warm and persistent communication style.

* Excellent attention to detail and follow-through.

* Comfortable working independently and being measured against clear weekly outcomes.

* Experience marketing consulting, training, HR or professional services is a plus.



**Schedule and compensation**



* Part-time, approximately 15–20 hours per week.

* Some availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours is required.

* Starting rate: $4 USD per hour.

* $15 bonus for each qualified appointment that is attended.

* 1% bonus on collected revenue from new clients directly sourced by you.

* $2 bonus for each qualified target prospect who attends one of our designated webinars.

* Compensation review after the first 60–90 days based on reliability, lead quality and results.



This position will begin with a paid 30-day trial.



**To apply**



Please submit:



1. A brief introduction describing your B2B appointment-setting experience.

2. A description of how you have used HubSpot or another CRM.

3. Your current availability and preferred working hours.

4. A short sample
 you would send to an HR director to invite them to a workforce-development webinar.

5. A 60–90-second video or voice note introducing yourself.

6. One example of a campaign where your outreach generated booked or attended sales appointments.



Please begin your application with the phrase **“Build the Hive”** so we know you read the complete description.

I will provide the topic and script.



Your job will be to turn the script into a complete, professional YouTube video.



Responsibilities:



- Create a full 15–20 minute faceless documentary video

- Source relevant historical images, archival footage, stock footage and public-domain visuals

- Match visuals carefully to the narration

- Create or provide a natural English voice-over

- Add background music and sound effects where appropriate

- Add subtitles/captions when needed

- Use smooth transitions and documentary-style pacing

- Make the video engaging enough to maintain viewer retention

- Avoid irrelevant or repetitive visuals

- Keep the visual style consistent across future videos

- Deliver the final video ready for upload to YouTube



Important:



All images, footage, music, and visual materials used in the video must be safe for commercial use on YouTube.



Do not use copyrighted content without permission.



Only use:

- royalty-free footage

- licensed stock footage

- public domain material

- Creative Commons content that is allowed for commercial use

- or original/self-made visuals



If attribution is required, you must provide it clearly.



I do not want any copyright claims, reuse issues, or YouTube policy problems caused by the visuals, footage, or audio used in the video.



You are responsible for making sure all materials used are safe and suitable for YouTube monetization.



The style should feel like a professional history documentary, not low-quality AI-generated content.



You should have:

- Experience editing long-form YouTube videos

- Experience editing faceless YouTube channels

- Strong English

- Good storytelling and pacing

- Experience sourcing copyright-safe footage

- Experience with history/documentary content is a big plus

- Ability to produce a natural, professional English voice-over



Compensation is negotiable and will depend on your experience, portfolio, editing quality, and whether you can provide the full package including voice-over and copyright-safe visuals.

title: Commercial Collections Supervisor
description:
The Collections Supervisor is responsible for overseeing a team of commercial collections agents engaged in the recovery of outstanding debts from business clients. This role requires hands-on supervision, performance coaching, and strategic support in the execution of collection activities. The ideal candidate will have direct experience in commercial debt recovery and a working knowledge of UCC lien enforcement and notification procedures.



Key Responsibilities

In addition to managing a small portfolio of high value accounts, the ideal candidate will also have the following responsibilities:



*Team Supervision & Development:

Lead and support a team of collections agents, providing daily oversight and performance guidance.

Conduct regular coaching sessions and assist in onboarding and training new hires.

Promote adherence to established procedures and collection strategies.



*Collection Oversight:

Provide support and 2nd talk-offs on complex or escalated debtor accounts, particularly those involving secured debt or UCC lien enforcement.

Ensure that agents follow internal and client-specific protocols for effective and compliant recovery efforts.

Review and assist in the preparation and delivery of UCC lien notices and follow-up communications.



*Performance Monitoring:

Track agent performance using key metrics such as recovery rates, call volume, and resolution time.

Deliver regular performance updates and identify areas for improvement.

Collaborate with leadership to optimize team efficiency and results.



*Compliance:

Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations, including the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and relevant provisions of the Uniform Commercial Code (Article 9).

Monitor team activities for adherence to compliance standards and participate in periodic training.



*Reporting & Analysis:

Generate performance and activity reports for internal review.

Analyze trends in recovery outcomes and make recommendations for strategy improvements.



*Technology & Tools:

Use collection platforms and CRM tools to manage workflows, assign tasks, and document account activity.

Support tea
mbers in troubleshooting software-related issues.



Qualifications



*2 - 3 years of solid leadership experience in a supervisory or managerial role in the collection industry.

*Demonstrated ability to build and lead high-performing teams, fostering a culture of accountability and success.

*Strong negotiation, communication, and team leadership skills, with the ability to conduct second talk-offs.

*Proficient in CRM platforms and collections software.

*Experience in commercial debt recovery, with solid expertise in secured transactions and UCC lien enforcement (preferred).

*Highly detail-oriented and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

*Strategic thinker with the ability to develop and implement plans that adapt to change.



To apply, submit a copy of your resume and why you are perfect for the job.

title: Squarespace VA — SEO Page Publishing, Blog & GBP (13-Week Project)
description:
About Us

Da' Roofers is a family-run roofing, siding, gutter, and skylight company 

serving Maryland homeowners, based in Brinklow, MD. We're running a 

13-week Maryland-focused SEO and content project and need a reliable, 

detail-oriented VA to execute it in Squarespace.



The Project

We provide the copy, structure, meta content, schema, and image direction 

— your job is to build, publish, and maintain it correctly in Squarespace 

on a phased, week-by-week schedule (not a sprint).



What You'll Do

Page Publishing

- Build new local service pages using content/copy/structure we provide

- Add meta titles, meta descriptions, and alt text exactly as provided

- Insert schema markup (JSON-LD) into Squarespace's code injection panel

- Set up internal links between pages as directed



Technical SEO Cleanup

- Fix flagged issues on existing pages: oversized images, missing/duplicate 

  page titles, meta descriptions, H1 tags, canonical URLs, and broken 

  redirects — using fixes we provide

- Batch-compress images using a free tool (e.g. TinyPNG) before re-upload



Blog Maintenance

- Publish 2 blog posts/week from our existing content bank (all posts are 

  pre-written — no writing required)

- Clean up outdated location references in both new and previously 

  published posts, using our provided text

- Source and place images per our written image direction/concepts 

  (stock images for general content; project photos once available)



Google Business Profile

- Post to GBP 2x/week using content we provide (we'll grant Manager access)



Must Haves

- Proven Squarespace experience — share 1-2 example sites you've built or edited

- Comfortable with code injection (we provide exact code, you place it)

- Basic Google Business Profile experience (or willingness to learn — it's simple)

- Strong attention to detail — work needs to closely match provided specs

- Good written English, responsive communication

- Comfortable working in phases over ~13 weeks rather than one sprint,

  averaging 7-9 hours/week



Scope: fixed at ~95 hours total across the 13 weeks, capped.

Potential for the GBP posting role to continue on an ongoing basis after 

the project, if it's a good fit.

title: Bookkeeping Virtual Assistant

We are proud to have earned a place on the Inc. 5000 List of the Fastest Growing Companies in the United States from 2021 to 2025, as well as the 2021 Better Business Bureau Torch Award for Ethics. These recognitions reflect our commitment to quality and integrity in everything we do. Additional recognitions include:



Recognized in the PCT Top 100 as one of the largest and fastest-growing pest control companies in North America

Named to the Gator100 List of fastest-growing Gator-led companies four years in a row, ranking No. 24 in 2025

Ranked #1 Pest Control Company in Florida by Top Rated Local™ based on more than 10,000 five-star reviews

Winner of the 2023 FLCAJ Readers’ Choice Platinum Award for pest control services



Your Opportunity:

We are seeking a highly analytical, tech-savvy, and detail-oriented Bookkeeping Virtual Assistant to support our team in maintaining accurate financial records, managing day-to-day bookkeeping functions, and improving the overall efficiency of our internal financial processes. This role also includes optional responsibilities such as assisting with payroll, budgeting, and light administrative support.



You’ll play a key role in maintaining the integrity of our financial data and reporting, supporting leadership with timely insights, and helping streamline routine tasks. The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and experienced in bookkeeping, with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.





Key Responsibilities:

Record and Categorize Financial Transactions:

Accurately record all financial transactions via Dext-including income, expenses, reimbursements, and adjustments-into the appropriate general ledger accounts. Ensure timely data entry and correct classification in accordance with company policies.



Assist with Payroll Processing:

Collaborate with the Bookkeeper to prepare, review, and process bi-weekly or monthly payroll through Bamboo HR. Ensure accuracy of time entries, tax withholdings, and benefits deductions. Maintain confidentiality and compliance with applicable labor and tax regulations.



Support Licensing and Compliance:

Help manage the renewal and documentation of business licenses through FDACS, permits, and insurance policies. Track expiration dates and assist in filing necessary paperwork to maintain company compliance.



Maintain Financial Spreadsheets and Reports:

Create and update spreadsheets. Ensure accuracy, version control, and clarity in financial documentation shared with leadership.



Provide Administrative Support:

Assist with light administrative duties, including organizing digital records, managing shared folders, and preparing supporting documents for audits or executive review.



Participate in Regular Meetings:

Join video calls for onboarding, training, project updates, performance reviews, share progress, and ask clarifying questions.



Perks:

13th month bonus

10 days of paid time off (PTO) during the first year

6 US Holidays (see note below)

Paid Training

Employee Referral Bonus



Specifics:

Full-time role (40 hours per week)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EDT/EST (GMT-5), including a 1-hour unpaid lunch break. This role may require availability for a rotating half-day Saturday shift (8:30 AM–12:30 PM EST), approximately once monthly or more as needed.

Note: While three U.S. holidays are fully observed (Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year's), there may be a need for coverage on other U.S. holidays such as Memorial Day, Independence Day (July 4th), and Labor Day due to high lead volume. This is rotational. 





Must have:

Strong high-speed Wi-Fi

Reliable microphone and camera

Organized and professional home setup



Qualifications:

Experience with bookkeeping platforms (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero, Wave)

Proficiency with Google Sheets or Excel (formulas, pivot tables, etc.)

Strong attention to detail and analytical skills

Excellent written and spoken English communication

Please include the word gold in your introductory message if reading this

Comfortable working independently and in collaboration with leadership





Why Native Pest Management:

At Native Pest Management, we focus on creating long-term careers for our employees with clear paths for growth. Our goal is to become the largest privately held pest control company in Florida, which will continue to open doors for advancement.

With over 10,000 five-star reviews across platforms like Google, Yelp, and Angie’s List, our team takes pride in delivering exceptional service that keeps customers coming back and referring us to others. That reputation is a direct reflection of the hard work and professionalism of our staff.

The pest management industry is rapidly expanding and offers a recession-resistant career path.

We are committed to providing valuable, comprehensive, and affordable benefits to our employees. Each year, we review our programs to ensure they continue to meet these goals and support our team’s evolving needs. We’re committed to your success now and in the future.





This role requires exceptional English language proficiency, with precise pronunciation and highly effective conversational skills, to ensure clear, confident, and professional communication with team members.





What to Expect During the Hiring Process:

Once you submit your application, our HR team may reach out for an initial phone or Zoom interview. Candidates who move forward may then be invited to an additional follow-up interview, via Zoom or GoogleMeet. Applicants must submit a 2–3 minute video recording (or video link) speaking in English. Please introduce yourself and briefly discuss your relevant work experience and skills. We encourage you to speak naturally and conversationally rather than reading from a script, as this helps us better understand your communication style in real-world work situations. Light notes or bullet points are fine, but avoid reading word-for-word. Applications submitted without a video link will not be considered. The application process involves a review, and selected candidates may be invited for a screening or interview which may include a typing test. Applicants unwilling to participate in an interview need not apply. Incomplete applications or those not following instructions will not be considered.



Background Check Statement:

Employment is contingent upon successfully completing a background check, which may include a criminal history verification or equivalent clearance based on the applicant’s country of residence. Please also include the word dollar in the subject line of your application. Any required documentation must be completed within two (2) weeks of the start date.



Native Pest Management is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, or any other status protected by federal or Florida law.

You need to listen carefully, acknowledge concerns respectfully, handle objections professionally, and help patients feel comfortable reconnecting with the office. Clinical, billing, complaint, or sensitive questions must be escalated to the appropriate office team.



Responsibilities include calling overdue patients, booking hygiene and follow-up appointments, recording call outcomes, setting follow-up reminders, coordinating with office teams, handling common objections, and escalating concerns when needed.



This is a healthcare-related role, so confidentiality and professionalism are extremely important. You will not provide clinical advice.



Requirements:

- Excellent spoken English

- Warm, compassionate phone presence

- Strong interpersonal and listening skills

- Experience handling objections or difficult conversations

- Experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, customer service, dental reception, healthcare, or sales

- Reliable internet, computer, and headset

- Quiet work environment

- Ability to work during Pacific Time business hours

- Strong attention to detail

- Comfortable using scripts, spreadsheets, calling tools, and CRM-style systems



Dental experience is preferred but not required. Experience with patient recall, hygiene reactivation, service recovery, appointment booking, or complaint handling is a strong asset.



We are hiring immediately.

title: Senior Backend Web Developer & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Immediate Start



We are looking for an exceptional senior backend engineer to build the technical foundation behind a global consumer platform combining music, personal development, gamification and community.

We already have developers who can turn designs into screens.

We are NOT looking for another frontend developer.

We are looking for the engineer responsible for making everything behind those screens work, reliably, securely and at massive scale.



Our ambition is to launch to a global audience and build infrastructure capable of handling 100,000-200,000+ active users at the same time without bugs, including large numbers of users simultaneously listening to our music.



Your Responsibility



You will own or lead the architecture behind:

- Backend infrastructure

- Cloud architecture

- APIs

- Databases

- Authentication

- User accounts

- Music/audio delivery

- Subscription systems

- Country-based pricing

- Payments

- Character progression

- XP systems

- Challenges

- Streaks

- Leaderboards

- Notifications

- Social features

- Analytics infrastructure

- Security

- Monitoring

- Scalability

- Performance



Your job is not simply to make features work.



Your job is to make sure they continue working when we scale from 1,000 users to 10,000 users to 100,000+ simultaneous users.



Scale Is Critical



Candidates should understand how to architect systems for extremely high traffic.



You should be experienced with concepts such as:

- Horizontally scalable backend architecture

- Load balancing

- Auto-scaling

- CDN architecture

- Audio / media streaming infrastructure

- Object storage

- Caching

- Database scaling

- Database replication

- Queues and asynchronous processing

- Rate limiting

- API performance

- High availability

- Fault tolerance

- DDoS protection

- Monitoring and alerting

- Logging

- Backup and disaster recovery

- Infrastructure as Code

- CI/CD

- Load testing

- Stress testing



Before launch, we expect the infrastructure to be properly stress-tested for major traffic spikes.



Proof Required

We are only interested in engineers with an exceptional and verifiable track record.



When applying, provide:

1. Products or platforms you have personally worked on

2. Your exact responsibility within those products

3. Peak number of users / requests / traffic those systems handled

4. Examples of backend systems you personally architected

5. Cloud infrastructure you have designed

6. Examples of scaling challenges you solved

7. Experience with high-volume media or streaming platforms

8. Experience with subscription applications

9. Technologies and cloud platforms you specialize in

10. GitHub or relevant technical work if available



We will specifically ask:

“What is the largest production system you have personally helped scale, and what exactly did you build?”



Generic portfolios will not be enough.

Technical Challenge



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to explain how they would architect our brand for a global launch with:

- 100,000+ concurrent users

- Users simultaneously streaming music

- iOS

- Android

- Web

- Global authentication

- Country-specific subscriptions

- XP and character progression

- Challenges

- Leaderboards

- Push notifications

- Large traffic spikes during music releases



You should be able to explain your architecture, infrastructure decisions, bottlenecks, failure scenarios and scaling strategy.



Who We Want

- We want someone who thinks like an owner.

- Someone who asks:

- “What happens if traffic increases 50x tomorrow?”

- “What is our single point of failure?”

- “What happens if the database becomes unavailable?”

- “What happens if 100,000 people press play at the same time?”

- “How do we make sure one viral moment doesn't take the entire platform offline?”

- “How do we know something is going wrong before users notice?”

- You should think beyond individual features and understand the platform as an entire system.



Salary: €2.500 - €3.500 per month



If you're the right person for this, sign up now and we'll contact you personally!



Kind regards,



Ryan

title: Video Editor
description:
We are 7 Figure Brand which is looking for a D2C Supplement Brand Video Editor looking to join our team! As our video editing specialist, you will be responsible for editing high-converting UGC ads, direct response video creatives,VSL’s and psychology-based video content to be used across paid marketing channels (primarily Meta).



We are looking to hire someone with 1.5+ years of ecommerce work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience editing paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC content,VSL’s direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with supplement/health brands.



Note:

- Don't apply if you can't do a small trial video for us.

- You will be prioritised if you send a curated drive portfolio. (Inside it should be 3 videos showing your best work. Make sure to include AI videos as well.)



Key Objectives:



-Edit 1-15 high-converting video ads per week from raw UGC footage and stock content

-Transform raw creator footage into polished, direct response ads optimized for Meta platforms

-Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics (CTR, Hook Rate, Hold Rate) through superior editing

-Create multiple variations and iterations of winning ad concepts quickly

-Use data from creative performance on Meta to analyze what editing techniques, hooks, and structures are driving results

-Work with our creative strategist to bring scripts and concepts to life through compelling editing

-Maintain organized asset libraries and editing workflows for maximum efficiency

-Provide quick turnaround times on revisions and new edits to support rapid testing cycles



Requirements:



-Fully remote

-Fluent in English

-Direct Response Editing Expertise: 1.5+ Years experience editing performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must

-Software Proficiency: Expert-level skills in Adobe Premiere Pro or After Effects or CapCut, Heygen, Veo 3, Higgfield is a must and familiarity with DaVinci Resolve. Mobile editing experience (CapCut mobile) is a plus

-UGC Editing: Extensive experience editing raw UGC footage into high-converting paid ads with native platform aesthetics

-Fast & Efficient: Ability to produce high-quality edits quickly without sacrificing performance. Speed is critical

-Creative & Data-Driven: Understanding of what makes ads perform (hooks, pacing, captions, sound design, effects) and ability to analyze performance data to inform editing decisions

-Portfolio Required: Must provide portfolio showcasing DTC video ads (preferably supplements, health, or e-commerce)

-No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn't know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work

-Excellent cultural fit as per our values above

-Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders

-Understanding of direct response principles and how editing impacts conversion

-Include word "Cherry" in your application to prove your legit. Include the word in the title.

- Your application won't be considered if it doesn't include the word as the "title" of your application.



Accountabilities:



-Edit 10-20 video ads per week from provided scripts, raw footage, and assets

-Create multiple variations of winning ads (different hooks, text overlays, pacing)

-Add compelling captions, text overlays, sound effects, and visual effects that enhance performance

-Maintain consistent turnaround times (24-48 hours for standard edits, same-day for urgent)

-Organize and manage all video assets, footage libraries, and project files

-Collaborate with creative strategist to understand video concepts and execute the vision

Source and integrate b-roll, stock footage, and motion graphics as needed

-Adapt editing style to emerging trends and platform best practices

-Review performance data on edited ads and identify patterns in what's working

-Iterate quickly on underperforming ads and create new versions based on data insights

-Create editing templates and systems to increase output efficiency

-Maintain brand consistency across all video content while optimizing for performance



How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate:



When hiring, we'll work with you to define the KPIs you'll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you're doing a good job after you start.



We plan to hire within ~1 to 2 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.



For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

This is a varied role covering customer support, ecommerce operations, admin assistance and Shopify support. You will work alongside our existing Customer Service Assistant, providing additional support throughout the year.



We need someone who can take ownership of recurring tasks, follow things through to completion and comfortably move between different areas of the business depending on what is required.



Key Responsibilities

1) Customer Support (Please note this will be a significant part of the role during Q4 and other busy periods)

- Help manage customer enquiries and more complex escalations.

- Assist with Trustpilot and customer feedback.

- Monitor social media comments.

- Investigate order, delivery, warehouse and Shopify-related issues.



2) Ecommerce Operations

- Track shipments and follow up outstanding issues.

- Assist with returns, chargebacks and ecommerce administration.

- Help with warehouse, stock and fulfilment queries.

- Maintain trackers, reports and accurate records.

- Follow up actions with team members and external partners.

- Handle routine operational issues independently where appropriate.



3. Shopify & Product Support

- Create and update Shopify products.

- Upload product information, imagery, prices and variants.

- Assist with product descriptions and launch preparation.

- Check product information for accuracy.

- Support product launches, restocks and website updates.

- Note: Shopify activity will vary throughout the year and increase around launches and restocks.



4. Admin & Marketing Support

- Assist with creator outreach and coordination.

- Assist with briefs, revisions and uploading ads.

- Help with routine coordination with agencies and external partners.



Essential Requirements

- Previous hands-on Shopify experience is essential.

- Previous ecommerce customer support experience.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Experience working independently in a remote VA or ecommerce role.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

- Confident using spreadsheets and online systems.

- Proactive and comfortable chasing outstanding actions.

- Good judgement about when to resolve something independently and when to escalate.

- Comfortable working UK business hours.

- Reliable and looking for a long-term role.



Preferred Experience

- Gorgias

- Fashion, apparel or activewear ecommerce

- Warehouse/3PL coordination

- Returns, chargebacks or shipping issues

- UGC/creator coordination



Hiring Process

Stage 1 – Application + Loom

- Please send your CV and a short Loom video covering:

- Your relevant customer support/ecommerce experience.

- The Shopify tasks you have personally carried out.

- An example of a problem you took ownership of and resolved independently.

- VERY IMPORTANT: Please include the word “Alpaca” in your application to show you have read everything



Stage 2 – Short Practical Exercise

- Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief exercise covering customer communication, Shopify/ecommerce knowledge, organisation and judgement.



Stage 3 – Video Interview

- Final candidates will meet us by video to discuss experience, availability, working style and long-term fit.



Final Step – Paid Trial

- Successful candidates will complete a short paid trial before moving into the long-term role.

title: Creative AI Video Producer for Pocket Party (Higgsfield + Seedance 2.5)
description:
Pocket Party is a mobile party-game app built around funny, social moments. We are hiring a creative and technically capable AI video producer in the Philippines to build a steady pipeline of short-form videos for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.



REFERENCE VIDEO

Our latest AI-generated Instagram video:





This reference was made quickly by our founder. Your job is to take this format and make it significantly better: stronger ideas, funnier execution, more natural human behavior, better character and scene consistency, better pacing, cleaner sound and a more polished final result.



THE PRODUCTION SYSTEM

You must be willing to work inside our supplied production system:

- Pocket Party provides the Higgsfield account and generation credits.

- Videos will be generated through Higgsfield using Seedance 2.5 and other approved models when appropriate.

- You will work in Codex connected to Higgsfield through the Higgsfield MCP. This is our core production workflow for developing concepts, building structured prompts, generating shots, tracking assets and iterations, and following the production process.

- You must follow naming, logging, continuity and quality-control systems carefully.



This is not mainly a traditional editing role. Most of the work is creative thinking, prompt and scene construction, AI generation, detecting weak outputs, regenerating or repairing them, and assembling the finished social video. Basic editing and design skills are still required.



WE NEED SOMEONE WHO

- Has real experience making finished AI-generated videos, not just attractive disconnected shots.

- Can create coherent multi-scene videos with recurring characters, believable action and visual continuity.

- Is highly creative, technically curious, intelligent and good at following a detailed system.

- Understands American and Gen-Z humor, social trends, hooks and short-form pacing.

- Can spot when AI footage looks fake, awkward or inconsistent and knows how to improve it.

- Has strong written and spoken English.

- Is comfortable using Codex and MCP-based tools, learning new models and improving the workflow over time.

- Can work reliably and communicate clearly in a remote team.



HOW TO APPLY

Send all of the following:

1. Three DIRECT, publicly playable links to finished videos you personally helped create. Do not send only a general portfolio folder or showreel.

2. At least one link must be a coherent multi-scene AI video with recurring characters or a continuous story.

3. At least one link must be funny, social-first or designed for TikTok/Reels/Shorts.

4. For every link, explain exactly what you personally contributed and which AI and editing tools you used.

5. Watch our Instagram reference above and write three sentences: what works, what should be improved, and what you would do differently to make the next version much better.

6. Tell us about your hands-on experience with Higgsfield, Seedance 2.5, Flow/Veo, Kling, Runway or comparable AI-video tools, and whether you are comfortable working through Codex and an MCP-based workflow.

7. Confirm your availability, timezone and whether you are interested in a long-term full-time role.



Applications without direct playable AI-video proof will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will have a video interview followed by a PAID practical test using a real Pocket Party brief. The right person can grow into a long-term full-time creative role with Pocket Party.
salary: Negotiable based on ability and fit

title: Vidrush Video Editor & Researcher – History YouTube Channel
description:
I’m looking for a reliable part-time YouTube video editor to help create long-form videos for a growing history YouTube channel.



Our videos are created using Vidrush, which automatically creates the initial video using the script, voiceover and visuals.



However, Vidrush does not always select the correct footage. It can sometimes use inaccurate, unrelated, repetitive or poorly matched visuals.



Your main responsibility will be to check the footage throughout the video and make sure it accurately matches the narration.



The Most Important Skill: Research



**Fast and accurate research is the most important skill for this position.**



Because this is a history channel, using the correct footage is extremely important for maintaining the trust of our audience.



You may need to find specific historical footage or images that are difficult to locate. You need to be able to research quickly, find suitable material, and determine whether it actually matches what is being discussed.



You may need to check:



* Ships

* People

* Locations

* Historical events

* Dates and time periods

* Uniforms and equipment

* Historical photographs and film footage



If Vidrush selects the wrong footage, you will need to research and find a better replacement. Sometimes this will require creativity and finding alternative ways to visually represent something when the exact footage is difficult to find.



 Important: Historical Accuracy & AI Images



You must be able to recognise AI-generated images and footage.



We do not want AI-generated images to be presented as genuine historical photographs or footage.



If Vidrush or an online search produces an AI-generated historical image, you should recognise it and find a genuine historical source or another appropriate visual instead.



our Responsibilities



* Use Vidrushto work with the automatically created video.

* Check the footage throughout the entire video.

* Make sure visuals accurately match the narration.

* Research and find better historical footage and images when necessary.

* Replace incorrect, unrelated, repetitive or poor-quality visuals.

* Avoid using AI-generated images as historical material.

* Be creative when the exact footage is difficult to find.

* Improve pacing and visuals where needed.

* Complete a final quality check before delivery.



Requirements



* Excellent and fast research skills — this is the most important requirement.

* Basic video editing skills.

* Strong interest in or understanding of history.

* Ability to identify incorrect or poorly matched historical footage.

* Previous Vidrush experience is a big advantage. 

* If you haven't used Vidrush before, you must be comfortable learning it quickly.

* Good attention to detail.

* Reliable, organised and able to work independently.

* Comfortable using Zoom for occasional online meetings and training sessions.



Working Together



At the beginning, we will have some Zoom meetings to go through the workflow, processes and expectations together so that everything is set up properly.



There may also be occasional Zoom meetings later when we need to explain a new process, make improvements to the workflow, or discuss any questions.



These will not be constant meetings — the main work is independent — but you should be comfortable communicating and working with me through Zoom when needed.



Position & Pay



* Part-time: 4 hours per day (can increase to full time after trial or stay as part time- up to you)

* Monday–Friday (but you can choose to work some weekends instead, up to you)

* 20 hours per week





**Starting rate: $3 USD/hour**



The first 2 weeks will be a paid trial period.



During the trial period, payment will be made weekly via Wise.



After the trial period, if your work meets the required standards and expectations, the rate will increase to **$4 USD/hour**.



There is also potential for further increases over time based on performance and reliability.



How to Apply:



Please send:



1. Examples of your previous YouTube editing work.

2. A short description of your editing and research experience.

3. Whether you have used Vidrush before.

4. Your availability.

5. Confirmation that you are comfortable starting at $3/hour during the two-week paid trial, with the rate increasing to $4/hour after the trial if the work meets expectations.

6. A short example of how you would research and find difficult historical footage.



Please include the words "Admiral Nimitz” in your application so I know you have read the description.

title: Short-Form Gaming Content Creator – Plix.gg
description:
Plix.gg is a browser games portal with 72,000+ games and 180K+ monthly

visitors. We're hiring one person to own our short-form video output

end to end: find the games, record them, write the hooks, cut the

videos, post them.



This is NOT an editing-only role. We do not send you footage. If you

only want to edit clips someone else planned, this isn't your job.





WHAT YOU DO

- Dig through our catalogue and find games worth a video

- Record gameplay yourself (clean screen capture, 1080x1920)

- Write your own hooks and concepts — you are the ideas person

- Edit 10-40 second videos: captions, sound design, pacing, effects

- Post to our accounts and log how each one performed

- Test alternative opening hooks and tell us what worked



Concepts that work in this niche (starting points, not a template):

- "I found the weirdest game on the internet"

- "This browser game should NOT be this good"

- "3 games to play when you're bored at work"

- "Can you beat this level?"

- "3 games to play with your friends, no download"

Or even could be meme videos 



OUTPUT

15 finished videos per week.

Each one gets posted to TikTok, Reels and Shorts.

5 videos per week ship with a second opening hook for A/B testing.



We measure retention and views, not file count. Tell us when a concept

is weak instead of shipping it to hit a number.



HOURS

We don't care when you work. No fixed schedule, no timezone overlap,

no clocking in. Everything is scheduled in advance, so nobody needs

to be awake at upload time.



VOICE AND AI

You do not need to appear on camera or use your own voice.

- AI voiceover: allowed and encouraged

- AI captions and script assistance: fine

- AI-generated B-roll, stock slideshows, or the same template repeated

  across dozens of uploads: not allowed





SETUP YOU NEED

- A PC that runs browser games smoothly and records at 1080p

- A stable connection — you'll be uploading 15+ videos a week

- CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve — your choice, we don't care

- You'll deliver project files alongside exports





REQUIREMENTS

- Strong short-form editing, with work to show

- You genuinely understand hooks and first-3-second retention

- You play games and can tell when one is actually interesting

- Good written English and a feel for what makes a Western gaming

  audience stop scrolling

- You can work independently. We give feedback weekly, not hourly.





PAY

$900/month (approx ?55,000), paid monthly via Wise.

Performance bonus on top, tied to monthly views across accounts.

13th month equivalent after 12 months.





HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with PLIX. Applications without it get deleted.



Send:

1. 3-5 short-form videos you edited. Say exactly what you did on each

   — did you shoot it, write it, or just cut it?

2. Your editing software

3. THREE video ideas for Plix.gg. Each one must name a specific game

   with its plix.gg URL, plus the exact opening line you would say.

   This is the part we actually judge you on. 

4. Your PC specs and a internet speed



Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial video: ?1,000, paid whether

or not we hire you. We run several trials at the same time.

title: Travel Video Editor for YouTube & TikTok
description:
I’m looking for a talented and reliable Video Editor to help me edit my YouTube vlogs and turn the longer videos into engaging short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.



I’m a beauty industry professional and educator, and I’ll be taking several exciting trips over the next year for my job and for personal travel. I’ll be filming a lot of vlog-style content throughout these trips, so I’m looking for someone who can take my raw footage and turn it into polished, entertaining videos.



What you’ll be doing



YouTube videos:

- Edit raw vlog footage into engaging YouTube videos

- Create a natural story and flow from lots of different clips

- Cut out unnecessary footage, pauses and mistakes.

- Add music, sound effects and transitions where appropriate

- Add clean, modern fonts/text on screen

- Add captions/subtitles where appropriate

- Add location names, map pins or other visual elements when relevant

- Create an overall polished, fun and professional look

- Help with pacing so the videos aren't boring or unnecessarily long

- Colour correction/basic colour grading and audio balancing



Short-form content:



- Take the long-form YouTube footage and identify the best moments for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts

- Create engaging vertical videos

- Add captions, text and appropriate effects

- Make the content feel native to TikTok/Reels rather than simply cropping the YouTube video

- Suggest potential clips/hooks that could work well as short-form content



The type of editor I'm looking for:



I don't want someone who simply cuts clips together. I want someone who has a good eye for storytelling and understands what makes content interesting to watch.



You should be:



- Creative and have a strong sense of visual style

- Good at storytelling and pacing

- Familiar with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts (i will ask for evidence)

- Comfortable editing vlog/travel/lifestyle content

- Good at choosing music and knowing when NOT to over-edit

- Able to create clean and professional text/caption graphics

- Detail-oriented

- Reliable and able to meet deadlines

- Comfortable working independently without needing constant instructions

- Open to feedback and able to learn my preferred editing style over time



Software



Please let me know what editing software you use. I’m open to Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut or similar, as long as you can produce a high-quality finished result.



Important



Please send examples of YouTube videos and short-form content you have personally edited. I particularly want to see vlog, travel, lifestyle or talking-to-camera content rather than only highly scripted promotional videos.



I will also ask shortlisted applicants to complete a small paid trial edit using some of my footage. This will help me find someone whose editing style is the right fit.



Ongoing work

This could become an ongoing position for the right person. I have multiple trips planned over the next year, as well as other content I will be creating, so I would ideally like to build a long-term working relationship with someone reliable.



When applying, please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your video editing experience

3. The software you use

4. Links to your best YouTube edits

5. Links to your best TikTok/Reels/Shorts edits

6. Your hourly rate or rate per video

7. Your usual turnaround time

8. Your availability and working hours

9. Your internet connection and computer specifications



Please start your application with the words "TRAVEL EDITOR" so I know you've read the full job post.



I'm looking for someone who is creative, reliable, has excellent attention to detail and genuinely enjoys making content look and feel great.



I'm happy to teach you my preferred style and give feedback. The goal is to find someone who can eventually take the raw footage, understand the story, and create the finished content with minimal direction.

title: Direct Response Video Ads Editor
description:
Direct Response Video Ads Editor - 



We are an ambitious e-commerce brand committed to building a strong presence in the online retail space. As we build and begin to scale our advertising efforts, we are looking for a skilled and creative Direct Response Video Ads Editor to join our team.



Our marketing strategy relies heavily on compelling video ads designed to convert viewers into buyers. We need someone who understands the psychology of direct response advertising and has the technical skills to produce high-quality, engaging video content that drives results.



You'll create high-impact video ads from pre-provided B-roll, with the creative freedom to bring your own ideas to the table. Your ability to craft effective hooks, structure engaging narratives, and utilize AI tools to enhance creativity will be critical to your success. This role requires someone who can not only edit quickly but also deliver content that performs exceptionally well on platforms like Meta Ads.



We are particularly interested in candidates who are motivated to work exclusively with us and contribute to the long-term growth of the brand.



Key Responsibilities:

* Editing direct response video ads using tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar apps.

* Crafting high-converting video ads with three hooks per video to maximise engagement.

* Utilising AI tools like ElevenLabs and AI Personas to enhance creativity and delivery.

* Testing all videos on Meta Ads to evaluate performance and refine creative approaches.

* Continuously optimising editing techniques to improve ad performance.



Qualifications & Skills:

* Proven experience editing direct response ads for e-commerce brands.

* Proficiency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar editing software.

* Familiarity with AI tools like ElevenLabs, claude and AI Personas.

* Strong understanding of direct response advertising principles.

* Ability to work quickly and deliver high-quality content under tight deadlines.

* Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate.



Application Process:

To ensure you have read this listing carefully, please begin your application with the phrase: “I create high-converting video ads.” At the bottom of your application, please include the following:

* A brief description of your experience with video editing and direct response ads.

* Links to previous work, especially relevant e-commerce ads.

* Your availability and how quickly you can start.

This is a remote position with flexible hours, and compensation will be determined based on your experience and skill level. We are excited to find a talented individual who is eager to grow with us and consistently deliver outstanding results.



Apply now to join our team and help us take our advertising efforts to the next level.

title: YouTube Video Editor
description:
About Viral Vault Studios



Viral Vault Studios is a digital content company that produces entertaining, informative, and high-retention faceless YouTube videos. Our content covers topics such as celebrity controversies, celebrity health, anime recaps, and other trending subjects.



We are looking for a creative, skilled, and detail-oriented YouTube Video Editor who can work quickly, collaborate effectively, and consistently deliver professional-quality videos.



Role Overview



The YouTube Video Editor will transform scripts and voice-overs into engaging long-form videos designed to maintain viewer attention.



This role requires more than assembling clips. You must understand storytelling, pacing, audience retention, visual sourcing, sound design, and YouTube Fair Use. You will also work collaboratively with other editors on shared projects, so communication, organization, and consistency are essential.



Key Responsibilities:

• Edit long-form YouTube videos using scripts and voice-overs.

• Create strong pacing, engaging openings, and clear visual storytelling.

• Match B-roll, interviews, news clips, screenshots, photos, social media posts, and graphics to the narration (if applicable).

• Use visual changes, pattern interrupts, transitions, music, sound effects, motion graphics, and other effects where appropriate.

• Identify slow or repetitive sections and improve them through editing.

• Ensure visuals are relevant, varied, and supportive of the story.

• Properly sync and balance narration, music, sound effects, and visuals.

• Use third-party content in a transformative and copyright-conscious manner.

• Track and organize the sources used in each video.

• Follow company editing SOPs, style guidelines, deadlines, and feedback.

• Collaborate with other editors working on the same project.

• Review and quality-check all work before submission.



Qualifications

• Previous experience editing YouTube or other social media content.

• Strong understanding of YouTube storytelling, pacing, and audience retention.

• Experience sourcing B-roll, stock footage, interviews, news clips, images, screenshots, and social media content.

• Working knowledge of YouTube Fair Use and copyright-conscious editing.

• Proficiency in at least one professional editing program, including: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut Desktop

• Ability to follow detailed instructions and adapt based on feedback.

• Strong communication, organization, and attention to detail.

• Ability to work efficiently and consistently meet deadlines.

• Available to work 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM Philippine Time (PHT).



To be considered for this role, you MUST complete the following:



- Submit your updated resume

- Provide a portfolio or sample work

- For those selected, a test task is required to demonstrate ability (instructions will be provided)

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
About the Role 



We are looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Specialist who combines strong recruitment execution with strategic sourcing and candidate evaluation skills. 



You will be responsible for finding qualified talent, developing effective sourcing strategies, screening candidates, and building strong candidate pipelines across a variety of professional and specialized roles. 



Key Responsibilities 

- Develop and execute sourcing strategies based on the requirements of each role. 

- Identify the right talent pools, platforms, communities, and channels to find qualified candidates. 

- Proactively source both active and passive candidates. 

- Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate interviews to assess qualifications and fit. 

- Identify candidate strengths, gaps, and potential red flags. 

- Build and maintain qualified talent pipelines. 

- Work with hiring stakeholders to understand hiring requirements and provide candidate recommendations. 

- Monitor sourcing effectiveness and adjust strategies when the right candidates are not being identified. 

- Stay updated on effective recruitment, sourcing, and talent acquisition techniques and tools. 

- Manage candidates through the recruitment process and ensure a professional candidate experience. 



Requirements 

- Minimum 3 years of hands-on Talent Acquisition or Recruitment experience. 

- Strong sourcing and candidate research skills. 

- Experience with active and passive candidate sourcing. 

- Strong resume screening and candidate evaluation skills. 

- Experience conducting phone or initial interviews. 

- Ability to develop sourcing strategies for different types of roles. 

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills. 

- Good judgment, organization, and attention to detail. 

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple hiring priorities. 

- Experience recruiting across different functions is highly preferred. 



Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience recruiting for professional and specialized roles across areas such as accounting, finance, consulting, marketing, operations, technology, and other business functions. 

- Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter or advanced LinkedIn sourcing. 

- Familiarity with Boolean search, X-ray search, and other sourcing techniques. 

- Experience with ATS/recruitment platforms and recruitment analytics. 

- Familiarity with AI-powered recruitment and sourcing tools. 



What We're Looking For 

- Someone who is both hands-on and strategic—a recruiter who can not only process candidates but also figure out where to find the right talent, how to attract them, and how to determine whether they're genuinely a good fit. 

- We value quality over application volume and want someone who can continuously improve our sourcing and talent acquisition approach.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
About the Role:



We are a fast-growing D2C brand in the health and wellness space. We sell physical information products — primarily premium hardcover books — to a large and loyal customer base, and we are expanding into new product formats and conditions. Our products have already reached over a million homes worldwide.



The goal is to help 100 million people get healthier at home — and that requires products that are not just good, but genuinely exceptional. Design is a core part of how we get there.



This is not a role where you make things look nice. This is a role where you make products that change how people engage with their health — products so well-designed that they are easy to use, hard to put down, and impossible to ignore on a shelf. We want Apple-level intentionality applied to every page, every layout, every cover, every touchpoint. Design that solves the customer's problem AND sells — not design that is beautiful but impractical.



Our customers are primarily women aged 50 and older. They are not designers. They are not tech-savvy. They need information presented in a way that feels welcoming, credible, and effortless to use. If the design is cluttered, intimidating, or confusing — it does not matter how good the content is. They will not use it. Your job is to make sure they use it.



Why this role exists now:



We have built a strong product team and a content pipeline that is producing genuinely helpful health resources. But the design quality has not kept pace with the ambition. Our current products look good — but they do not look world-class. To reach 100 million people, the product has to be something people love holding, love using, and want to show their friends. That requires a designer who breathes this, who obsesses over every detail, and who understands that great design for this audience means clarity, warmth, and practical beauty — not trendy minimalism or flashy aesthetics that do not serve the user.



What You Will Own:

• The visual and experiential design of all physical products — setting and enforcing a design standard that is genuinely world-class. Every book, every page, every cover, every insert should feel like it was made by a company that cares deeply about the person holding it.

• Product usability and information design — making dense health information accessible, scannable, and actionable for an older demographic. This means smart use of typography, hierarchy, illustration, color, and layout to guide people through content without overwhelming them. You understand that design is not decoration — it is communication.

• Design system and brand visual language — building a cohesive design system across our product line so that every new product feels like it belongs to the same family. As we expand into new health conditions and product formats, visual consistency and quality need to scale with us.

• Cover and packaging design — the first impression matters enormously in our business. You own the visual impact of our products from the moment a customer sees an ad to the moment they open the package. Covers need to feel premium, trustworthy, and compelling.

• Illustration and visual asset direction — whether working with illustrators, AI tools, or producing assets yourself, you ensure that every visual element in the product serves a purpose. Illustrations should educate, not just decorate. Diagrams should clarify, not confuse.

• Collaboration with the content team — working closely with writers and researchers to ensure that the content and design evolve together, not in isolation. You push back when content is not structured in a way that supports good design, and you adapt your design when the content demands it.

• Creative input on new product formats — as we explore digital companions, apps, and new physical formats beyond books, you bring a design perspective to what these products should feel and look like. You think about the full customer experience, not just the page.

• Raising the standard of the entire team — you are the person who sets the bar. Junior designers, editors, and contractors look to your work and your feedback to understand what "great" looks like here. You mentor, review, and elevate.



You Are the Right Fit If:

• You have a portfolio that demonstrates genuinely exceptional design work for physical or information products — books, magazines, packaging, editorial, or consumer products. We want to see work that makes us stop and look twice.

• You deeply understand information design and typography. You know how to take complex content and make it feel simple, inviting, and easy to follow. You have designed for audiences who are not young, not tech-native, and not design-literate — and you made it work beautifully.

• You obsess over details — spacing, alignment, color relationships, paper texture, print quality. You care about things most people would not notice, because you know that the sum of those details is what separates a good product from one people love.

• You understand that design must serve the customer's problem, not the designer's ego. You can explain why every design choice helps the person use the product better, trust the information more, or take action more easily. Beautiful but impractical does not interest you.

• You have experience designing for print production — you understand CMYK, bleed, binding constraints, paper weight, and how design translates from screen to physical product. You have shipped real physical products and dealt with the constraints that come with manufacturing.

• You are versatile across illustration, layout, typography, and brand design. You may not be the world's best illustrator, but you can direct illustration work, produce strong visual assets, and integrate diverse visual elements into a cohesive product.

• You are comfortable with AI design tools and eager to push them further. We are an AI-forward company and expect senior team members to leverage these tools to move faster and explore more possibilities — while maintaining the quality bar.

• You are a self-directed creative who thrives with high autonomy. You do not need to be told what good looks like — you already know, and you push the team toward it.



Nice to Have:

• Experience designing for health, wellness, or educational content — you understand the balance between credibility and accessibility.

• Background in editorial design, publishing, or information-dense product design at scale.

• Experience designing for an older demographic (50+) — you understand readability, visual hierarchy, and trust signals that matter to this audience.

• Illustration skills — hand-drawn, digital, or AI-assisted — that can add warmth and clarity to health content.

• Experience with packaging design and unboxing experiences for physical consumer products.

• Familiarity with design for digital products (apps, interactive guides) in addition to physical — as we expand into these formats.

• Experience building and maintaining design systems across a growing product line.



What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days:

• You complete a thorough audit of our current product design — books, covers, packaging, digital assets — and present a clear, honest assessment of where we are versus where we need to be, with a prioritized roadmap for getting there.

• The next product release shows a visible step-change in design quality — not a total overhaul, but a clear signal that the standard has been raised. People inside the company and customers should notice the difference.

• You have established a strong working relationship with the content team — design and content are being developed together rather than design being applied after the fact.

• A coherent design system is taking shape — foundational decisions about typography, color, illustration style, and layout patterns that will scale across future products.

• You have identified where AI tools, new processes, or additional resources can accelerate design quality and output — and progress is underway on at least one of these.

• The product team and leadership feel the impact — there is a new level of design thinking and intentionality in how we approach every product decision.



To Apply:



Please submit your application at zurl.to/Ts9o?source=CareerSite and include the following:

1. Your portfolio — we want to see physical or information product design work that demonstrates exceptional craft and intentionality. Show us your best work and tell us why it worked.

2. How you approach designing for a non-technical, older audience — what principles guide you when the user is not a designer.

3. An example of a product where your design directly improved usability or customer outcomes — not just aesthetics.

4. How you think about balancing beauty with practicality in information-dense products.

5. Compensation expectations.

come off a proven concept and because you will have templates and organized

brand assets, not because you are inventing 75 original ideas from nothing. But

it is a production-heavy role. If you need a week per concept, this is not your

job, and there is nothing wrong with that.



What we're looking for:

- 3+ years of graphic design experience, with a portfolio that clearly shows

  static ad work for e-commerce/D2C brands (please include a link)

- Strong command of Figma

- Solid typography, layout, hierarchy and color skills; you know how to make an

  ad readable on a small phone screen

- Understanding of direct response principles: hooks, benefits, social proof,

  clear CTAs

- Fast turnaround without sacrificing quality; comfortable producing many

  concepts per week

- Excellent written English and clear, proactive communication

- Reliable internet and your own computer

- You can be online 8am to 12pm Eastern every working day. That block is fixed,

  because it is when the buyers are working. The rest of your hours are yours

  to arrange. If you are in the Philippines that core lands roughly 8pm to

  midnight your time, so go in with your eyes open.

- You are comfortable with AI image tools and honest about using them. They are

  allowed here. Hiding them is not.



Nice to have:

- Experience with simple motion/GIF versions of static ads

- Experience designing landing page sections or
 graphics

- Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager creative specs



What we offer:

- $1,200/month floor. That is a floor, not a ceiling, and there is real

  headroom for a strong independent contributor who needs very little

  management.

- Paid through Deel on the first of each month

- Employee or contractor, whichever you prefer. We hire directly.

- 13th-month pay, paid Philippine holidays, and 7 days of flexible leave

- A Claude subscription and AI-first workflows

- Direct daily feedback from the people spending the money, so you learn what

  actually wins instead of guessing





TO APPLY



Apply here, and only here:







Please do not apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Do not send a message, a resume, or

a portfolio link through this platform. We do not read them. They are not

sorted later and not reviewed in a batch. The link above is the only channel,

and anything that arrives another way is missed, not deprioritized.



The application is a single page and takes about 45 minutes. It includes a real

design exercise: you will critique four live static ads, rank them, and rebuild

the one you rank weakest. You source the assets yourself and you may generate

images with AI, so do not worry about matching the original artwork exactly. We

are reading your thinking and your craft. Do not start it until you have an

uninterrupted block, because it is not something you can do in pieces.



Finalists get a paid project interview: roughly a couple of hours of real work,

paid $100, before any hire decision. We do not ask for free work, and we do not

hire off a portfolio alone.

* reliable with deadlines

description:

About the Role



We're looking for an experienced eCommerce Marketplace Manager to own and grow our brand's presence on 
. You don't need prior Walmart experience — if you've mastered Amazon Brand Management (pricing strategy, PPC/ads, inventory, catalog health), you already have 80% of the skillset. We'll train you on the Walmart-specific tools and mechanics in your first 2–4 weeks.



This is a high-ownership role. You'll be expected to run your accounts with minimal oversight — flagging issues, making pricing calls, and reporting proactively rather than waiting to be asked.



What You'll Own



Pricing & Competitiveness: Monitor daily price-competitiveness scores vs. Amazon/competitor pricing; recommend and execute price-match decisions with margin impact clearly calculated

Fulfillment (WFS): Track WFS inventory health, flag at-risk/OOS SKUs, coordinate replenishment with the supply team

Advertising: Manage Sponsored Search/SEM campaigns — budget allocation, ROAS optimization, campaign testing

Promotions: Plan and execute promotions (flash deals, clearance/surplus pushes) with margin awareness built in from the start

Reporting: Deliver accurate revenue and profit reporting (not just top-line GMV) — profit numbers must reconcile with finance/BI dashboards

Catalog & Account Health: Resolve listing suppressions, price suppressions, buy box issues, and account health flags — escalating to Walmart Seller Support when needed and following through to resolution



What We're Looking For



2+ years managing brand/seller accounts on Amazon (or another major marketplace) — pricing, PPC, inventory, and catalog management

Strong grasp of unit economics: must be able to distinguish gross margin from net profit, and factor in platform fees (referral/commission, fulfillment fees) — not just COGS

Demonstrated self-direction: a track record of surfacing problems and status updates proactively, not needing to be chased for them

Comfortable owning escalations end-to-end — filing tickets/cases, following up, and closing the loop without hand-holding

Data-fluent: comfortable pulling numbers from a BI dashboard/reporting tool rather than reconstructing them manually

Clear, specific written communication (Slack/email) — status updates should be concrete, not vague





Nice to Have (not required)



Prior Walmart Seller Center or WFS experience

Experience with SEM/search ads outside Amazon (Google Ads, Walmart Connect, etc.)



Additional Information



This is a fully remote position and requires a reliable high-speed internet connection and a personal computer or laptop.

About Us



We're a fast-growing marketing agency based in Dubai that helps roofing/renovation companies across the UK generate more leads, more appointments, and more roofing/renovation jobs through Meta advertising.



We currently work with approximately 40 active clients and have a team of 7 specialists covering paid advertising, CRM automation, lead nurturing, appointment setting, and operations.



We're now looking for an exceptional Meta Ads specialist to take ownership of our clients' advertising performance across both Meta Ads and GoHighLevel.



This is not a junior media buyer role. This is not a role where you'll be handed SOPs and told exactly what to do.



We're looking for someone who can confidently walk into an account, identify opportunities, build winning campaigns, improve results, and drive measurable growth with minimal supervision — and who doesn't just execute, but spots gaps in our systems and proposes better ways of doing things.

You should be highly analytical, highly proactive, comfortable making decisions based on data, and genuinely innovative — someone who improves the systems they work in, not just operates within them.

2. Experience with home improvement businesses

3. Experience with high-ticket lead generation

4. Experience working within agencies managing multiple client accounts

5. Experience suggesting or building GoHighLevel automation/workflow improvements, not just operating what's already built



Your Responsibilities:



Meta Campaign Management



Build and launch Meta advertising campaigns

Manage and optimise existing campaigns

Monitor daily performance across all client accounts

Scale successful campaigns

Identify underperforming campaigns and improve results

Conduct ongoing split testing

Monitor lead quality, not just lead volume

Make strategic recommendations based on data



Creative Strategy



Develop new ad angles and campaign concepts

Write compelling ad copy

Create hooks and offers

Brief our video editor on winning creatives

Analyse creative performance and iterate quickly



Performance Analysis



Track KPIs across all accounts

Analyse lead quality

Monitor CPL, conversion rates, booked appointments, and revenue outcomes

Produce clear recommendations for improving results

Identify trends across multiple accounts



Client Success



Ensure clients receive consistent lead flow

Take ownership of campaign performance

Work closely with our internal team to maximise results

Contribute ideas that improve client outcomes

Salary & Growth Path



We believe in paying for proven performance, not just tenure. Your compensation will grow quickly if you deliver:



$1,750 USD/month to start

$1,850 USD/month after 60–90 days of proven performance

$2,000+ USD/month after 6 months, for someone who's demonstrated the ownership and results we're looking for



This isn't a token gesture — if you're the A-player we're describing, you'll see that reflected in your pay quickly.



What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days:



Take ownership of approximately 30 client accounts

Improve campaign consistency across accounts

Reduce wasted ad spend

Increase lead quality

Implement a structured testing framework

Introduce creative strategies that improve conversion rates

Become the go-to Meta advertising expert within the company

What We Don't Want



This role is NOT suitable for:



Beginners

General virtual assistants

People who only know how to duplicate campaigns

Media buyers who rely entirely on SOPs

People who need constant supervision

Anyone without significant lead generation experience

How To Apply



Please submit:



Your CV

A Loom video (3-5 minutes)

Total Meta ad spend managed

Industries you've worked with

Your three best lead generation case studies

The highest-performing campaign you've ever managed

The average monthly ad spend you currently manage

Your experience with GoHighLevel — what you've built, automated, or improved for a client

Why you believe you're qualified for this role



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.



Final Note



We're building a long-term team of exceptional people. If you're someone who takes ownership, loves solving problems, thrives on performance data, and knows how to generate high-quality leads through Meta Ads, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:

Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brands in the US. We run a fully remote content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators across the world.

Here's the type of video you'll be making: 
/reel/DZj8I9aok7A/





What Success Looks Like

Within your first month, you're consistently turning raw, unpolished footage into simple, scroll-stopping TikToks and Reels — and pitching your own video ideas, not just executing ours. Come up with new video concepts and creative visuals, not just execute given formats

Spot what's working in your own edits and on TikTok, and apply it fast

An eye for it — you can watch a set of clips and tell exactly which are good, which aren't, and why

Experience editing TikTok/Reels — including simple text-on-screen videos, not just talking heads

You're a genuine, daily TikTok/Reels consumer — you understand this content natively

Creative opinions — you can look at raw footage and see the visual story that will perform

Comfortable working from rough, unpolished source footage

Proficiency in CapCut

Clear written English and reliable daily communication

Nice-to-Haves



Trend radar — you spot rising audio, text styles, and formats before they peak

Not a Fit If



Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

Compensation & Working Style

Growth: We invest in committed people — courses, software, and mentorship



How to Apply
