title: Amazon Account Manager (Project-Based, Remote)
description:
Amazon Account Manager (Project-Based, Remote)



About us

We're Threesy, a fast-growing Amazon agency based in Vienna, Austria. Team of 10, adding new clients every month, working across Europe with Germany as our largest market. More at 



This role is 100% remote and project-based. You'll be one of the people who directly moves our clients' revenue.



What you'll do



Own accounts: You manage a portfolio of Amazon seller accounts across different niches and you're responsible for their performance, not just their upkeep.

Grow revenue: Taking an account from 10k to 50k a month, or 50k to 300k, is the actual job. You know which levers do that — keyword ranking, promotions, listing adjustments, deal planning — and in which order to pull them.

Optimize listings: Titles, bullets, backend keywords and A+ Content, so products get found and convert.

Manage inventory: You keep accounts out of stockouts and overstock, and flag problems before they cost the client rank.

Work with our PPC team: You align organic and paid so they push in the same direction.

Onboard new clients: You build a custom strategy per client and then execute it yourself.

Handle flat files: Bulk uploads, variation fixes, error reports. You know your way around them.

Own Amazon support cases: You open them, follow up, and push until they're actually resolved.

Bring ideas and run them: Direct contact with the whole team, including the founders. Good ideas get implemented, not filed.



Must-haves — please don't apply if you don't meet these



You've managed around 10 Amazon accounts at the same time, each with a large catalog.

You've worked on the European Amazon marketplaces.

You've worked at an Amazon agency before.

At least 3 years in Amazon account management.

Strong English, written and spoken.

Proactive and communicative — you raise issues early instead of waiting to be asked.



What else you should bring



Seller and Vendor Central experience with accounts you actually grew.

E-commerce copywriting, comfortable with ChatGPT and DeepL.

Strong analytics. You read the data and draw the right conclusion from it.

Marketing instinct. You understand why a customer buys, not just which fields to fill in.

Tools: Helium 10, Data Dive, ChatGPT, Google Drive, Slack.

Organizational discipline. Ten accounts only work if nothing falls through.



What we offer



100% remote, permanently. No office requirement.

Core hours 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM Manila time (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM Vienna). The rest of your day is yours.

A long-term partnership. We want someone who grows with us over years, not a two-month gap-filler.

Short paths. Direct contact with the founders. No layers, no long approval loops.

Real ownership. Diverse accounts where your decisions visibly move the numbers.

A team that already works this way. Several colleagues in the Philippines are part of our core team, not outsourced help.



Compensation

Project-based. Pay depends on your experience, track record and the number of accounts you take on but you can make up to 1.000 usd. If you want to discuss the rate, say so in your application. We track time.



Straight up: the workload isn't identical every month. Busy months are heavier, quieter months lighter. If you need a fixed guaranteed monthly income, this isn't the right fit. If you're comfortable with project work and want a reliable long-term client who pays on time, we'd like to hear from you.



How to apply

Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph only. Please don't
 us or reach out on LinkedIn — we only review applications from this listing.



Send us:



A one-page letter on why you're a good fit, Your resume, Examples of Amazon accounts you've grown, with numbers where you can share them



Put "Amazon Account Manager" in your headline so we know you read this.



We reply within one business day. Then: a 10-minute call, a test task on a real account, decision. Two weeks maximum.



Only apply if you're genuinely an Amazon expert. This isn't an entry-level role.



We're looking forward to hearing from you!
